jobs.title: TEAMS Sales Operations Coordinator

At FIGS, we celebrate, empower, and serve those who serve others. Through TEAMS, we're bringing that same mission to entire healthcare institutions by outfitting hospitals, clinics, schools, and healthcare systems with the scrubs they deserve. To support our growth, we are seeking a **Sales Operations Coordinator.** The ideal candidate issomeone who loves details, enjoys building processes, and wants to help a fast\-moving sales team spend more time selling and less time stuck in admin updates..



This is a high\-impact, behind\-the\-scenes role for someone who's organized, process\-driven, and passionate about clean operations.

**Clean Up the Backend:** Manage and maintain product collections, pricing data, and customer records across HubSpot and internal tools. Spot issues before they become problems.

**Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Work closely with Sales, Finance, CX, and Marketing to ensure alignment, accuracy, and speed across teams. Be the glue.


**Build Repeatable Processes:** As we scale, help document best practices and optimize workflows so the system grows with us.


### **Who You Are**


* **Organized**: You thrive in a clean spreadsheet and never let things fall through the cracks.
* **Operationally strong:** You like knowing how everything works and where it can work better.
* **Process\-minded:** You're always looking for ways to improve how work gets done.

* HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify or similar CRM experience
* Intermediate Excel/Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, vlookups, data cleanup)
* Bonus: experience or interest in SQL, Airtable, or database tools
* High attention to detail and pride in getting it right

### **Why This Role Rocks**


* You'll make a real impact on day one
* You'll get exposure to multiple functions across the company
* You'll help build something new and scalable
* You'll be part of a mission\-driven brand that's changing healthcare


Let's show the world what TEAMS can do.

* At FIGS, your base salary is one part of your total compensation package. This role's base salary range is between $29 and $31/hr. Actual hourly rate is determined based on a number of factors, including but not limited to your relevant skills, qualifications, and years of experience.


*Additional Compensation and Benefits*


* Other compensation and benefits offered include:
* + Comprehensive benefits and perks package focused on your well\-being, including premium medical, dental and vision coverage, and full access to wellness services through Breethe and Classpass. 100% FIGS\-sponsored life insurance and disability insurance
	+ Amazing 401(k) program, with a company match up to the first 6% of your contribution
	+ Generous paid time off \- We have 12 company holidays. For salaried team members, we offer flexible vacation. For our hourly team members, we offer up to 3 weeks of accrued vacation
	+ Meaningful time away for baby bonding, including parental leave, new parent care meals, and a transition back to work for primary caregivers

	+ Access to FIGS Vet, Discounted Pet Daycare, Discounted Pet Insurance, and so much more…

**A little bit about us…**



FIGS, Inc. is a founder\-led, direct\-to\-consumer healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand that seeks to celebrate, empower and serve current and future generations of healthcare professionals. We redefine what scrubs are by creating technically advanced apparel and products that feature an unmatched combination of comfort, durability, function and style, all at an affordable price. Through these customer relationships, FIGS has built a community and lifestyle around a profession, revolutionizing the large and fragmented healthcare apparel market and becoming the industry's category\-defining healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand.



Our Threads for Threads initiative is integral to our mission to improve the lives of healthcare professionals on a global scale. Founded alongside FIGS in 2013, Threads for Threads donates scrubs to healthcare professionals working in resource\-poor countries around the world.

jobs.title: Outside Sales & Account Manager – Property Management & Restaurant Accounts
jobs.description:
**Commercial Account Manager – Outside Sales, Plumbing Services (LA)**

EZ Plumbing – North Hollywood, CA  
Full\-time \| Salary \+ commission  
$48,000 base salary \+ uncapped commission \| $70,000–78,000 first year at quota \| $85,000–110,000 years two and three

EZ Plumbing has served the LA area since 1989\. We're hiring one person to build and own a book of commercial accounts: property management companies, HOAs, apartment buildings, and restaurants. Half the job is landing them. The other half is keeping them, growing them, and being the person they call. You get paid on everything your accounts spend with us for as long as they stay yours.

This is a field role. You'll be in property management offices, on job sites, and in restaurant back doors, not behind a desk.

The two halves of the job

**Landing accounts**

* Cold walk\-ins, calls, and follow\-ups to property managers, HOA boards, building owners, and restaurant operators across the LA metro
* Get EZ Plumbing onto vendor lists, get rate sheets accepted, and get maintenance agreements signed
* Deliver our vendor packet (license, insurance, W\-9, references) and walk them through it
* 15\+ in\-person visits and 40\+ total touches per week during your first year

**Managing accounts**

* Quarterly check\-in with every account in your book, in person or by phone, and a visit anytime an account goes quiet
* Own renewals: annual rate sheet updates and maintenance agreement renewals
* Grow the account: turn a one\-time repair customer into a scheduled program (drain jetting, sump and storm drain maintenance, backflow testing, water heater service, grease and floor drain service for restaurants)
* Be the first call when a property manager has a problem with a job. You don't fix it, you own it: get dispatch and the tech involved, follow it through, and call the customer back
* Stay on top of your accounts' invoices. You know the property manager, so you call before accounting does
* Track account health in ServiceTitan: last job date, revenue trend, open receivables. Nothing in your book goes 90 days without a touch
* Weekly report to the owner: new accounts, visits, accounts touched, at\-risk accounts, receivables over 60 days

Your first year is roughly 70% hunting and 30% managing. As your book grows, that flips. By year three most of your time is managing 60 to 80 accounts that pay you every month.

**Who we're looking for**

* 2\+ years outside sales, door\-to\-door, or field\-based B2B experience where you kept the accounts you signed. Route sales, uniforms, pest control, commercial cleaning, foodservice distribution, security, HVAC, or anyone who's sold to property managers: we want to talk to you
* You can walk into an office cold, get past the front desk, and leave with a name and a next step
* You follow up. Relentlessly. You have a system and you can describe it
* You've kept accounts for years, not just signed them, and you can tell us how
* You're comfortable being the person a customer calls when they're unhappy
* Organized enough to run a 50\-account book without letting any of them go cold
* Valid California driver's license and clean driving record
* Comfortable with 90% of your week in the field
* No plumbing experience required. We'll teach you what you need to sell it and manage it

**How you get paid**

* $48,000 base salary ($4,000/month), guaranteed
* $150 for every new account you sign, paid when their first invoice is paid
* 3% of everything your accounts pay us, labor and materials, for two years from the day they start, then 1% for as long as you keep the account active
* $2,000 quarterly bonus for hitting your account quota, keeping 90% of your book active, and keeping their bills current
* Year one at quota: $70,000–78,000\. Year two with a built book: $85,000–95,000\. Year three: $95,000–110,000, most of it recurring

The account management side is where the money is. The 1% that continues after year two, the retention bonus, and the growth from turning repair customers into maintenance programs are all paid for keeping accounts, not signing them.

Two things to know up front: commissions pay when the customer pays, not when the job is booked. And an account stays yours only if you're actively working it. Sign it and forget it and it goes back to the house.

**What we provide**

* Company vehicle or $500/month vehicle allowance, plus gas card
* Company phone and laptop
* All sales materials: rate sheets, one\-pagers, vendor packets, business cards
* Paid sick leave per California and City of LA law, 5 days vacation year one, 10 days year two

Not offered: health insurance, 401(k)

Schedule  
Monday to Friday, you set your own days within business hours. Exempt outside sales position, no overtime.

To apply  
Submit your resume and answer the screening questions. We read every answer. Candidates who pass move to a 15\-minute phone screen, then a ride\-along day with the owner.

EZ Plumbing is a family\-owned, C\-36 licensed plumbing contractor (CSLB \#583868\), 11478 Burbank Blvd, North Hollywood, CA 91601\.

Pay: $48,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Application Question(s):

* Describe the last job where most of your week was spent in the field making cold contacts. What did you sell and to whom?
* Walk me through your follow\-up system. What happens after a first visit where you got a name but no commitment?
* Tell me about an account you personally kept for two or more years. What did you do to keep it, and what did you do when they were unhappy?
* How did you track your accounts in your last role? What told you an account was about to leave?
* How many in\-person cold visits did you average per week in your last sales role?
* Do you have a valid California driver's license and a driving record insurable by a commercial policy?

Experience:

* Outside Sales, Field Sales, or Account Management.: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in

**About Soundtrap: Soundtrap is a cloud\-based digital audio workstation (DAW) that is reimagining how music and podcasts are created. Made by music producers, songwriters, and audio experts, our goal is to help you unlock your creative potential.**

**About the role**
==================

**At Soundtrap, we strive to make music creation and podcast production simple and accessible to everyone. We are now looking for an Education Specialist to join our dedicated US EDU team.**  

  

**Soundtrap is a cloud\-based audio recording platform that makes it easy for creators to produce music, podcasts, and other audio projects, right in the browser.**

**Our education platform, Soundtrap for Education, is used by thousands of schools and districts worldwide to give K\-12 students the ability to create, tell stories, and explore with sound. Through collaboration, creativity, and access to professional tools, we give the next generation a voice.**

**As our Education Specialist, you are the on\-the\-ground half of a proven engagement model. Our districts renew because someone trains their teachers, runs events their students remember, and shows up in the building when it counts. You will develop and deliver our professional development program for district partners nationwide, run onboarding and training for newly licensed schools, and co\-execute activations, camps, mobile studio events, and the SoCal Beat Battle alongside our Strategic Accounts and Partnerships Lead, including a career readiness initiative reaching thousands of young people.**

**The role suits you if you left the classroom but never stopped wanting to be around students and teachers, and you like a week that mixes virtual training, school\-site visits, and a hands\-on event day that ends with students performing something they made.**

**What you will do**
====================

* **Develop and deliver our professional development program for district partners nationwide, customizing every session to the district's goals, subjects, and stage of rollout. Some virtual, some in\-person. Travel required up to 30%.**
* **Build the PD program itself as it grows: session catalog, resources, delivery standards, and paid engagements as demand scales.**
* **Run onboarding for newly licensed schools: teacher training, LMS setup, rostering, and launch support.**
* **Provide core lifecycle support for accounts so account executives can spend their time selling instead of servicing.**
* **Co\-execute on\-the\-ground engagement across our largest West Coast accounts and community programs: activations, camps, mobile studio deployments, and the SoCal Beat Battle, including setup, facilitation, and teardown.**
* **Support delivery and documentation of a corporate\-funded career readiness initiative: rosters, attendance, and outcome evidence.**
* **Help account executives adopt our engagement playbook: what to run with an account, when, and how.**
* **Identify growth opportunities and work alongside territory managers to uncover new avenues for seat expansion.**
* **Track delivery, usage, and follow\-ups, and flag at\-risk accounts early.**

**Who you are**
===============

* **A former classroom teacher, with music, arts, or CTE experience preferred. You have instant credibility with teachers because you have been one.**
* **Deeply comfortable with audio technology: DAWs, audio production, beat\-making, and podcasting. You can teach it because you actually use it.**
* **Connected: you bring an existing network of school\-site and district relationships and the instincts to grow one.**
* **Experienced in designing and delivering professional development for school districts, not just one\-off demos.**
* **A skilled and engaging presenter with strong communication skills, virtual and in person.**
* **Willing to travel, including some evenings and weekends when needed, and are comfortable with the physical side of events.**

**Nice to have: familiarity with LMS and rostering ecosystems (Schoology, Canvas, Google Classroom, Clever, ClassLink), knowledge of VAPA and Arts, Media and Entertainment CTE pathways, event production experience, and basic CRM hygiene.**

**Where you will work**
=======================

**The location for this role is Southern California based. Expect a mix of virtual delivery to districts nationwide and regular on\-the\-ground work at school sites and events, with travel as part of the job.**

**With us, you get to work in an innovative environment with a strong team spirit, where your contribution makes a real difference. If you are passionate about helping teachers bring creative and meaningful learning tools into their classrooms, we would love to hear from you!**

**Company Description**
-----------------------


Givebutter is the most\-loved nonprofit fundraising and CRM platform, empowering millions of changemakers to raise more, pay less, and give better. Nonprofits use Givebutter to replace multiple tools so they can launch fundraisers and events, use donation forms and donor management (CRM), send emails and text blasts—all in one place. Use of the Givebutter platform is completely free with a 100% transparent tip\-or\-fee model.


Givebutter has been certified as a Great Place to Work every year since 2021, and is the \#1 rated nonprofit software company on G2 across multiple categories.


Our mission is to empower the changemaker in all of us. We believe giving should be fun, so you’ll want to do it again, and we also believe that work should be fun, so that you’ll have the greatest impact. We are excited to hear from talented people who want to work with other talented people in making the world a butter place—and have fun along the way.

**Role Description**
--------------------


The Sales Development Representative, Outbound, is responsible for generating net\-new pipeline by proactively identifying, researching, and prospecting into nonprofit organizations that could benefit from Givebutter. This role is for someone who thrives on the challenge of building conversations from scratch: through cold calls, personalized emails, and social outreach, and has the energy and resilience to consistently fill the top of the funnel. Success here requires a drive to exceed activity targets, a hunter mentality, and a genuine belief in the mission of the nonprofits we serve.

* Use performance data and feedback to improve outreach messaging, sequences, and targeting.
* Stay informed about Givebutter’s products, customer stories, and nonprofit fundraising trends to make outreach relevant and helpful.

jobs.title: Business Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT CRAWFORD \& ASSOCIATES**


Crawford \& Associates, Inc. is a geotechnical engineering, engineering geology, and construction materials testing firm founded in 2012, now with over 85 employees across nine offices in California and Washington State. We're a team of engineers, geologists, and specialists who love solving tough problems, whether that's a bridge foundation, a water line, a new school, or the next big development. We build long\-term partnerships with our clients, give advice they can count on, and have fun doing it.  

**JOB SUMMARY**


Crawford \& Associates, Inc. is hiring a Business Development Coordinator for our Costa Mesa office that we opened this year. This role is a split between business development and recruiting. You will help find and win new work across Southern California, and help find and hire the people who deliver it. You will report to the Business Development Specialist and work closely with our principals, project managers, and construction services leadership.  

  

If you are a person who likes research, building relationships, and working with cool people, we want to hear from you.  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Business Development (approx. 50%)**** Research and track Southern California public agency opportunities, including capital improvement programs (CIPs), council agendas, planning documents, and bid/RFQ postings.
* Screen incoming leads for fit with Crawford's services and route them to the right principal or project manager with supporting research.
* Build competitive intelligence, including which firms have historically won civil and geotechnical work with target agencies.
* Maintain accurate opportunity, client, and contact information in Crawford's lead tracking system.
* Prepare for and participate in weekly proposals and business development meetings.
* Support client outreach and relationship building with agencies, prime consultants, and contractors.
* Coordinate and attend industry conferences, association events, and client meetings.

***Recruiting Support (approx. 40%)**** Partner with the Business Development Specialist, who oversees recruiting, to divide and manage open requisitions.
* Handle day\-to\-day recruiting work, with a focus on entry\-level and field roles such as engineering technicians, inspectors, interns, and staff engineers and geologists.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Indeed, job boards, referrals, and university partnerships.
* Post job openings, screen applicants, conduct initial phone screens, and schedule interviews.
* Manage candidate pipelines and keep records current in JazzHR, our applicant tracking system.
* Coordinate with hiring managers on interview feedback and next steps.
* Represent Crawford at career fairs and campus events, primarily in Southern California.

***Operational Support (approx. 10%)**** Provide light administrative support to the Costa Mesa office as needed.
* Assist with special projects in business development, recruiting, and HR as assigned.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 1 to 3 years of experience in business development, recruiting, sales, or a similar client\- or candidate\-facing role.
* Ability to travel throughout Southern California, with occasional overnight stays.
* Valid California driver's license and reliable transportation.

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines with minimal supervision.
* Team player who works well with engineers, field staff, and leadership.

  

**WORKING CONDITIONS**


This isn't a desk\-all\-day job. You'll split your time between our Costa Mesa office and getting out into Southern California: meeting clients, representing Crawford at industry events and conferences, and connecting with students at career fairs. You'll play a key role in helping us win work and supporting the people who do it. Your home base runs Monday through Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, with the occasional evening or weekend event mixed in.  

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**


Crawford \& Associates, Inc. offers a comprehensive benefits package including employer\-paid medical coverage, dental and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) plan with company matching, paid holidays, and a progressive PTO program. Additional perks include monthly cell phone reimbursement, professional membership dues and annual licensure fees (case\-by\-case), FE/EIT and PE exam fee reimbursement, and access to HSA, FSA, EAP, and CalPerks resources. Most benefits begin the first of the month following an initial 90\-day introductory period.  

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**


Crawford \& Associates, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Crawford prohibits discrimination, harassment, and retaliation on the basis of race, religion, color, sex or gender, disability or medical condition, marital status, age, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodation is available for qualified individuals with disabilities and for religious beliefs and practices.

jobs.title: Dispatcher / Flight Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Full\-Time \& Part\-Time Positions Available

Orange County Flight Center (OCFC) John Wayne Airport (SNA) – Santa Ana, California

About Orange County Flight Center

Orange County Flight Center (OCFC) has proudly trained professional pilots for more than 45 years at John Wayne Airport, one of Southern California's busiest commercial airports. As an FAA Part 141 and Part 61 flight school, we are committed to safety, professionalism, and exceptional customer service while training the next generation of aviators.

We are currently seeking organized, dependable, and customer\-focused Dispatchers / Flight Operations Coordinators to join our growing team.

\- We are seeking a highly organized and professional Flight Operations Coordinator (Dispatcher) to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong administrative or office management background with exceptional organizational, communication, and multitasking skills. Knowledge of aviation operations, flight schools, or dispatch procedures is preferred, but candidates with excellent administrative experience and a willingness to learn will be strongly considered. This position is essential to the safe and efficient operation of our FAA Part 141 flight school and requires outstanding attention to detail, the ability to follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced aviation environment.

Key Responsibilities

· Coordinate daily flight operations, aircraft scheduling, and instructor assignments.

· Schedule aircraft and flight instructors efficiently while maximizing fleet utilization.

· Immediately update aircraft availability and return aircraft to the schedule as soon as they are released from maintenance or become available.

· Communicate scheduling updates promptly with instructors, dispatch staff, maintenance personnel, student advisors, and management.

· Maintain accurate dispatch records and ensure all scheduling information is current.

· Welcome students, visitors, and prospective customers while providing exceptional customer service.

· Answer incoming telephone calls and emails professionally.

· Monitor aircraft scheduling conflicts and proactively resolve operational issues.

· Assist students with appointments, flight scheduling, and training coordination.

· Follow all Orange County Flight Center Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and departmental policies.

· Maintain dispatch records and documentation in preparation for FAA inspections and Part 141 audits.

· Ensure dispatch operations comply with FAA regulations, company policies, and operational procedures.

· Maintain a high level of attention to detail when preparing and reviewing operational records.

· Process vendor invoices promptly and accurately, ensuring they are entered into the accounting system on time.

· Assist with maintaining organized office files, operational records, and administrative documentation.

· Support management with special projects and operational initiatives as assigned.

· Work collaboratively with maintenance personnel to minimize aircraft downtime and maximize aircraft availability.

· Help maintain a professional, safe, and organized work environment.

Required Qualifications

· Previous office, administrative, operations, or customer service experience.

· Exceptional organizational and time\-management skills.

· Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

· Outstanding customer service skills with the ability to build positive relationships with students, instructors, and customers.

· Strong conflict resolution and dispute\-handling skills, with the ability to remain professional, calm, and solution\-oriented when addressing customer concerns or operational challenges.

· Professional demeanor with a positive, team\-oriented attitude.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office and computer\-based scheduling systems (Schedule Point)

· Ability to follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and maintain accurate operational records.

· Reliable, punctual, dependable, and accountable.

· Ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and uphold the highest standards of professionalism.

Preferred Qualifications

· Knowledge of aviation operations, flight schools, or FAA Part 141 procedures.

· Dispatch or flight school experience.

· Experience with aircraft scheduling or aviation management software.

· Familiarity with FAA compliance, documentation, or audit preparation.

· Experience with invoice processing and administrative recordkeeping.

Pay: $20\.44 \- $23\.85 per hour

Work Location: In person

**Job Responsibilities :**

As an E\-Commerce Channel Marketing Coordinator, you will be a core executor on the Ecommerce Marketing team, taking ownership of daily operations across etail platforms. You will work with greater independence than an intern, driving content accuracy, listing quality, and channel performance. **Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Location:** Santa Ana, CA

**Job Description**

Pacific Formulations is a growing supplement company building and managing **multiple consumer health and wellness brands**. We are looking for a creative, highly organized, and results\-driven **Social Media Manager** to lead social media across our portfolio of supplement brands.

This is a hands\-on, multi\-brand position. You will be responsible for developing and managing social media strategies, creating content, coordinating UGC and creator content, building online communities, identifying trends, and using performance data to improve results across multiple brands.

The ideal candidate understands the supplement/DTC space, knows how to create content that gets attention, and can maintain a distinct voice and strategy for each brand.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage social media for **multiple supplement brands simultaneously**.
* Develop brand\-specific social media strategies and content calendars.
* Manage daily content across **TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube Shorts**, and other relevant platforms.
* Develop creative concepts, hooks, captions, CTAs, and content briefs.
* Coordinate and manage short\-form video, Reels, TikToks, Stories, UGC, and creator content.
* Research trends, sounds, formats, competitors, and emerging social opportunities.
* Work closely with influencers, UGC creators, affiliates, and the internal marketing/creative teams.
* Source, organize, review, and repurpose UGC and creator content.
* Manage comments, DMs, mentions, and community engagement.
* Support product launches, promotions, campaigns, and new brand initiatives.
* Monitor social media analytics and report on performance.
* Identify high\-performing content and develop additional concepts based on results.
* Test different hooks, creative formats, messaging, and content strategies.
* Ensure each brand maintains its own voice, positioning, and visual identity.
* Stay current with supplement, wellness, beauty, lifestyle, and DTC social trends.

**Qualifications**

* 3\+ years of professional social media management experience.
* Experience managing **multiple brands or accounts at the same time**.
* Experience with consumer products, preferably **dietary supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or DTC brands**.
* Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube.
* Strong short\-form video and content development experience.
* Excellent writing and communication skills.
* Experience working with UGC creators and influencers.
* Strong understanding of social media trends and platform algorithms.
* Ability to write compelling hooks, captions, and calls to action.
* Comfortable reviewing analytics and using data to improve performance.
* Highly organized with excellent project management skills.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple deadlines.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Supplement industry experience.
* Experience with **TikTok Shop** and social commerce.
* Experience with influencer and affiliate marketing.
* Experience with Shopify and e\-commerce.
* Experience with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools.
* Experience managing content production with photographers, videographers, designers, and creators.
* Knowledge of supplement advertising and social media compliance is a plus.

**Key Skills**

**Social Media Management \| Multi\-Brand Management \| TikTok \| Instagram \| YouTube \| Short\-Form Video \| UGC \| Influencer Marketing \| Affiliate Marketing \| Content Strategy \| Copywriting \| Community Management \| Social Analytics \| Social Commerce \| Trend Research**

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who **lives on social media** and understands what makes people stop scrolling.

You should be able to manage several brands at once while making each brand feel **different, relevant, and authentic**. You're creative enough to come up with ideas, organized enough to execute them, and analytical enough to understand what is actually working.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in growing a portfolio of **supplement and wellness brands across multiple social and e\-commerce channels.**

Pay: $72,000\.00 \- $82,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* Opportunity for advancement
* Paid time off
* Company parties
* Dental insurance
**WHO WE ARE:**  

We are an end\-to\-end Renewable Energy provider. We offer products to commercial and enterprise clients in EV Charging solutions, Fleet Electrification, Solar Micro\-grids, Energy storage, Hydroponic farming and Rain Water/Grey Water collection systems. We have been experiencing tremendous growth in all these areas and operate under several government rebate programs that ensure a steady and reliable flow of revenues. Our company handles the entire flow of providing these products and services beginning with Sales, Provisioning, Design and Engineering, Contracting and Construction, Servicing and Maintenance. If you are passionate about the EV industry and working with awesome teams in a fast\-growing company, we want to speak with you! Join us in making a meaningful impact!  

**Job Summary**  

This role entails making cold calls and sales calls to prospects across 4 states to sell them on our EV charging products while clearly articulating the incentives, rebates, and revenues for these products. Candidates must be able to fully comprehend a rather complicated business model and articulate it effectively to the prospect, and then work with internal tools to provide proposals, contracts, case studies, model scenarios, etc. This is an hourly role with commission.  

**Responsibilities**  

* Generate and qualify new sales opportunities by conducting high\-volume cold calls, outbound sales calls, direct marketing activities, and market research to identify potential clients within the EV charging and renewable energy industries.
* Engage with prospective and existing clients by understanding their needs, clearly communicating the benefits of our products and services, and demonstrating how our solutions can address their specific business needs.
* Present and promote company products and services through phone calls, electronic communication, in\-person meetings, sales presentations, promotional materials, and other sales activities.
* Develop sales opportunities from initial contact through close by conducting follow\-ups, developing sales proposals, preparing and presenting contracts, negotiating with clients, and responding to sales inquiries and concerns.
* Maintain accurate customer and sales information by keeping customer databases and sales activity records up to date, documenting calls and sales activity, preparing sales reports, and monitoring follow\-up activities for management.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing responsive customer service, taking incoming customer calls, following up on sales activity, addressing customer concerns, and ensuring overall customer satisfaction.
* Support sales and customer education efforts by developing and maintaining sales and promotional materials, conducting product training, and providing relevant case studies, model scenarios, and other supporting information to prospective clients.
* Develop new business through referrals and networking by sourcing client referrals, participating in sales events, and identifying additional opportunities to expand the company's customer base.
* Support market and competitive research by monitoring competitors, market conditions, product development, and industry trends, as well as conducting market research and surveys.
* Perform quality and sales activity follow\-up by monitoring product and service delivery, conducting quality checks, and reporting sales activities, customer feedback, and follow\-up needs to management.

**Requirements**  

* High school diploma required; BA/BS is a plus.
* 3\-5 years of experience as a Telemarketer.
* Superb communication and customer service skills, including the ability to remain calm under pressure.
* Excellent multitasking skills.
* Comfortable making cold calls to potential clients.
* A goal\-driven, results\-oriented mindset.
* Working knowledge of computer software, including Microsoft Office Suite.
* Knowledge of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT.

**Note:** This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required.

jobs.description:
**About ArtHaus Properties**### **The expanded ArtHaus Properties operating company is a wholly owned subsidiary of Arthaus Partners, purpose\-built to manage and scale our vertically integrated residential platform. This role offers a rare opportunity to help shape the future of operations at a company on the verge of doubling its footprint, bringing structure, innovation, and excellence to a portfolio with significant near\-term growth ahead. It’s an exciting moment to lead, build, and leave your mark.**

 **Leasing Operations Coordinator — ArtHaus Properties**  

 Oakland / East Bay, CA (Hybrid) \| $31–$33/hr \| Full\-Time

 **Ready to be the engine behind a growing leasing team?**


ArtHaus Properties is looking for a sharp, energetic Leasing Operations Coordinator to be the right hand to our Director of Leasing. This isn't a desk\-bound admin role — you'll be out at properties making sure every unit, tour, and ad actually lives up to our brand, while also digging into data and coordinating with a leasing team spread across the globe. If you're the kind of person who spots the one thing that's slightly off before anyone else does, and you're hungry to grow into bigger leasing operations and marketing responsibility, we want to talk to you.

 **What you'll do:**

* **You set the first impression.** Score curb appeal, entry sequence, common areas, and unit condition on every tour — flag it, don't fix it, and keep the ministaging inventory sharp and ready to deploy.
* **You're the last line of defense on brand.** Catch pricing, availability, and brand\-standard slip\-ups before they ever go live.
* **You make the numbers trustworthy.** Keep the systems clean and build the reports leadership actually relies on.
* **You keep leasing moving.** Help launch portfolio\-wide initiatives, group leasing outreach, and the AIGT (AI\-Guided Tour) program — and keep an eye on lead response and service quality across the team.
* **You're the closer's closer.** Jump in on application review and approval to help move renters across the finish line.

 **What you bring:**

* A few years in multifamily leasing, marketing, or operations (property management experience is preferred)
* An eye for detail and a genuine drive to make things better, not just check boxes
* Comfort with tech\-forward systems and the Google Suite
* Great communication — you can rally a global team and hold vendors accountable
* Reliable transportation to get around the Bay Area for property visits, primarily in Oakland
* A growth mindset — this is a launchpad role for someone who wants to build a career in leasing operations

 **Why ArtHaus:**  

You'll work directly with leadership, get exposure to every corner of the leasing and marketing operation, and have real room to grow as the role (and the portfolio) expands.

**Minimum Requirements**
========================

* Strong organizational and project\-management skills across competing deadlines and multiple properties.
* Comfort coordinating with global or distributed teams and holding service\-quality standards.
* Clear written and verbal communication; ability to translate standards into practical guidance for property\-level teams.
* Based in or willing to work from the Oakland/East Bay area, with ability to travel to properties as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Three or more years in multifamily leasing, marketing, or leasing operations.
* Experience overseeing quality control across property presentation, marketing materials, or brand standards.
* Working knowledge of Yardi (or comparable property management software) and reporting tools (Excel, Google Workspace).
* Familiarity with application review and Fair Housing\-consistent screening practices. Direct experience supporting a leasing leadership role.
* Background in centralized or corporate leasing operations across a multi\-property portfolio.
* Experience with group leasing outreach or business/community partnership development.
* Familiarity with competitive market research and pricing analysis.
* Yardi experience (any version).
* Familiarity with application review and Fair Housing\-consistent screening practices.

**Working Conditions**
======================

* Mix of desk\-based work (quality control, reporting, coordination) and property site visits for presentation walk\-throughs.
* Time\-sensitive cycles around unit turns, marketing launches, and initiative rollouts.
* Regular coordination with the leasing team.
* Based in Oakland/East Bay with periodic travel across the portfolio.

31 \- 33 USD per hour(ArtHaus Works)

Professionally represent Alexion in educating HPP disease customers and identifying patients impacted by HPP and ensure high levels of visibility to Alexion’s disease awareness initiatives and a high degree of customer satisfaction in territory. * Consistently achieving or exceeding sales objectives in assigned territory
* Developing and maintaining in\-depth knowledge of the product, market, and customers
* Developing and implementing strategically targeted account\-specific territory business plans in line with corporate strategy that reflect an in\-depth understanding of local market forces impacting product sales.
* Managing territory, analyzing the market dynamics to ensure territory sales goals are met, and updating business plans to reflect knowledge.
* Developing and maintaining strong in\-depth clinical, technical, and scientific knowledge
* Seeking out and qualifying leads and profile new accounts
* Educating on the diagnostic approach to the disease leading to a successful differential diagnosis and appropriate testing of patient populations
* Appropriately utilizing marketing tools and resources including power point presentations
* Leading the implementation of our patient\-centric partnership model in assigned territory which will include physicians, their staff, , clinics, and hospitals and provide high level product expertise and customer service to all accounts
* Making compelling and persuasive sales calls to designated customers resulting in sales of Alexion products.
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders, including: TLL(s), SAL(s), MSL(s), FRM(s), Market Access, Diagnostics, andother respective Enterprise partners
* Proactively interacting with Alexion management to refine product and market initiatives
* Effectively and efficiently managing time, priorities, CRM tool, resources, and workload
* Managing administrative responsibilities, submit reports on sales activities accurately and on\-time
* Performing work in alignment with and adheres to all Alexion’s Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and Alexion policies and procedures.

**You will need to have:**


* Degree in life science and/or business/marketing
* Proven, documented track record for delivering consistent ‘Top\-tier’ sales results demonstrate a consistent track record of success (Top 20% performance).
* Minimum 5 years Pharmaceutical or Equivalent Experience (e.g. Biotech or Medical Device)
* Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment, on a consistent basis
* Ability to gain consistent access \& develop strong, professional relationships for scientific exchange and promotion with healthcare providers in community and academic centers
* Demonstrated strategic territory management successes
* Effective verbal and written communication skills and organizational abilities
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving
* Ability to travel (minimum 50\-60%) within assigned territory on a regular basis which will include frequent overnight and some weekend travel.
* The duties of this role are generally conducted in a field environment. As is typical of a field\-based role, employees must be able, with or without an accommodation to: travel by public transportation, automobile, train, or plane; work comfortably in a clinical setting; use a computer; engage in communications via phone, video, and electronic messaging; problem solve; engage in complex and non\-linear thought, analysis, and dialogue; collaborate with others; maintain general availability during standard business hours.

**We would prefer for you to have:**


* Advanced or master’s degree preferred
* Biopharma Experience
* Top tier awards preferred i.e. President’s Club Award.
* Strong preference for sales experience in one or more of following:
	+ Endocrinology and Medical Genetics specialties and/or experience selling to physicians specialized in treating bone disorders
	+ Enzyme Replacement Therapy products
	+ Orphan, Ultra\-Orphan or rare disease experience
	+ Nephrology, Orthopedic surgery and Rheumatology specialties
	+ Self\-injected product
	+ Institution/academic center account experience is preferred

*The annual base pay for this position ranges from $152,636 \- $228,954\. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short\-term incentive bonuses, equity\-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans*

jobs.description:
### **The Role**



At Doppel, partnerships are a critical growth engine. We believe the best channel relationships are built on trust, transparency, and mutual success \- not just transactions. Our partners are an extension of our sales team, and when they win, we win.



We're looking for a Channel Account Manager to accelerate Doppel's Channel Strategy in the NorCal/Northwest team. You'll develop and grow relationships with leading security VARs, GSIs, Google Marketplace partners, and technical alliances to drive revenue and amplify Doppel's presence in the market. This role works hand\-in\-hand with our Enterprise and Mid\-Market sellers to help them exceed quota through strategic partner engagement and enablement.



### **What You'll Do**


* Build and manage relationships with key security VARs, GSIs, and technology alliance partners in the Northwest US.
* Develop joint business plans to drive pipeline and revenue growth through partners.
* Enable partners with the knowledge, tools, and resources to sell Doppel effectively.
* Collaborate closely with Enterprise and Mid\-Market sellers to co\-sell and accelerate deals.  

Manage partner onboarding, training, and performance tracking through systems like SFDC, Impartner, and Clari.
* Represent Doppel at partner and industry events; travel approximately 33–50% of the time.  

Share partner and field insights to influence go\-to\-market strategy, pricing, and product direction.

### **What We're Looking For**


* 5\+ years of channel and sales experience, ideally in security or cybersecurity.
* Strong existing relationships across the security channel ecosystem.
* Proven ability to build and manage partnerships that deliver measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technically complex products to partners.
* Experience using SFDC, Impartner, and Clari (or similar tools).
* Collaborative, entrepreneurial, and self\-directed \- you thrive in a fast\-moving, high\-growth environment.
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% of the time.

### **Why Join Doppel**


* $150,000 \- $170,000
* Competitive base \+ uncapped commission (with accelerators).
* Meaningful equity \- you'll share in Doppel's success.
* Remote\-first culture with flexible work.
* Unlimited PTO, health benefits, and parental leave.
* A high\-growth environment where your impact is immediate and visible.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue

**The Role**
------------


Reporting to the Director, Account Management \- Enterprise, you'll partner with our Enterprise Client Success Management partners to ensure our employer partners see value in the Handshake product in order to retain and grow a key segment of our business.
  

  

We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Manager to join our Employer Sales Team \- working with top employers across the nation to drive their early talent recruiting strategy. You will serve as the primary owner of a set book of existing employer partners, working closely with them to ensure they achieve their goals, build relationships with executives, and drive customer retention and expansion from onboarding through renewal.


This high\-impact role combines equal parts sales, relationship management and customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate has a proven record managing relationships at scale while driving renewals and expansions in a *Saas* technology company.

* Effectively renew, upsell and cross\-sell an assigned book of business of existing premium employer partners with an emphasis on growth
* Learn your book of business inside and out to effectively position Handshake’s value proposition, always linking it back to key business issues of the customer
* Develop and cultivate deep relationships with senior executives at the Director, SVP, VP, and C\-suite levels at our partners
* Develop new and creative ways to engage senior executives throughout the customer lifecycle and demonstrate Handshake’s value
* Partner closely with our Employer Customer Success Team to ensure customers adopt and are successful on Handshake
* Manage and present data and value\-driven Quarterly Business Reviews
* Enlist and inspire customers to participate in Handshake events and other marketing materials
* Manage overall customer loyalty, serving as internal advocate and escalation point to customers
* Assist in identifying and developing scalable account management tools and methodologies that can be applied across the Account Management team  

Help scale internal process to support hundreds of premium employers
* Becoming a Handshake expert, learning the ins and outs of HR and higher ed Tech

 *Must be willing to work onsite from our SF or NY office\- expected 5 days a week.*  

*Must be willing to travel as needed for customer engagements.*

**You Have**
------------

* At least 2\+ years of sales experience in Enterprise SaaS sales or Account Management, 5\+ years in a closing and quota carrying role
* Experience preparing renewal proposals, forecasting, and account planning
* A strong history of quota attainment and excellent performance on a high\-reaching team  

Experience with an evangelical sale, selling non\-discretionary software to executives at Fortune 1000 companies
* Experience managing customer relationships alongside a Customer Success team
* Experience using usage, data and results to demonstrate value and justify expansion
* An impeccable communicator with polished and professional sales presentation skills
* Experience operating in a high\-growth business environment like Handshake

**We Offer**
------------


Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life.

***The below benefits are for full\-time US employees.***


**Ownership:** Equity in a fast\-growing company


**Financial Wellness**: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching


**Family Support:** Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching


**Wellbeing:** Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend


**Growth:** $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development


**Remote \& Office:** Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office


**Time Off:** Flexible PTO, 15 holidays \+ 2 flex days


**Connection:** Team outings \& referral bonuses


Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers.


Compensation Range: $179\.2K \- $224K

jobs.title: Construction Account Manager
jobs.description:
Gordian is looking for an Account Manager based in Sacramento, who demonstrates professionalism, and construction knowledge and delivers results through their expertise while using Gordian’s extraordinary construction data and software. The primary responsibility for Gordian Account Managers is to provide support, and training, for products and services centered around Job Order Contracting (JOC) for various Clients.

  

JOC is a procurement method and construction process that helps federal, state, and local governments, schools, hospitals, higher education institutions, and others maximize efficiency, optimize cost savings, and increase construction quality.

 **Primary Responsibilities**

* Prepare and maintain schedules of detailed activities to accomplish procurement objectives within a specified time period for clients
* Implement and adhere to project procedures from project identification, assistance in overseeing the development and review of project scope of work, proposal review, ensuring contract compliance, through notice to proceed, and construction execution necessary to accomplish a specific objective for various Job Orders
* Ability to read and understand construction plans and specifications, with a depth of knowledge in conducting a comprehensive price proposal review as well as creating and review detailed construction line\-item proposals
* Ability to train contractors in Gordian software, client procedure and assist in client contract bidding
* Communicate clearly and effectively with clients and internal team members to ensure projects are completed on time and on budget
* Manage multiple accounts; develop positive working relationships with all customers.
* Drive client retention, renewals, upsells and client satisfaction.
* Work closely with Project Managers and Account Managers on day\-to\-day operational processes including, but not limited to contract renewals, prepare and maintain schedules to accomplish procurement objectives, troubleshooting, provide software training to client and contractor staff.
* Work closely with to determine root cause of customer success and failures and drive requirements for process enhancement and development as needed.
* Partner with internal cross\-functional teams to understand customer goals and key performance metrics and exceed those goals yearly.
* Provide input on new processes and workflow as needed.
* Focus on ensuring we maintain superior customer service levels, operational excellence and strategic insight.
* Collaborate closely with construction management firms to promote consistency and while developing standards and procedures.
* Work closely with Finance on billing setup and invoicing.
* Participate in Budget development and management, revenue forecasting
* Work with Sales and Business Operations team to develop annual program usage and benchmark report.
* Ability to monitor and follow through on all construction/project related activities to ensure work adequately reflects clients' needs and is executed in a continuous, prompt manner within the project budget.
* Ability to review contractors' requests for changes and, if appropriate, initiate job order supplementals
* Ability to interact with owner representatives, contractors, and facility end\-users, to minimize project concerns.
* Experience reviewing contractor's’ daily inspection reports, summarizing, and reporting on construction progress weekly, to upper management.
* Travel 50\-70% within assigned geographic area

 **Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field, or comparable work experience
* 5\+ years of construction procurement, construction management, project management, or general contracting related experience in both facilities and road construction preferred.
* Extensive knowledge and experience in public construction operations, pricing and contracting, including scope development and estimating/price proposal development
* High level analytical skills and problem\-solving capabilities, and the ability to effectively manage several projects simultaneously in development and in the field during construction.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills, strong interpersonal and team building skills, flexibility, strategic thinking, problem solving skills, goal driven, client obsessed, ability to deliver results, meets client and corporate deadlines, time management skills, self\-motivated, works well independently and in a group dynamic
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products, including Word, Excel, PowerBi, ability to develop and generate custom tracking documents and reports
* Background in construction documentation and administration preferred, but not required
* Job Order Contracting or IDIQ experience is preferred, but not required, comprehensive understanding of various public procurement and project delivery methods and requirements.

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high\-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.


We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward\-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission\-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

With uncapped commission potential, your career and the rewards that come with it are within reach. Enjoy uncapped commission potential as a Field Sales Representative, with top earners having the opportunity to make $100,000\.

Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training. Salary range is dependent on if all sales goals are met and/or exceeded.

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. Living the Well Life means you’re supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work\-life balance and well\-being. You’ll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

 **About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Branch Operations Associate Manager (LO) for our National Branch Network as part of the Consumer Banking and Lending division. Learn more about the career areas and business divisions at wellsfargojobs.com.

 **In this role you will:**

* Lead and supervise risk and the operations of teller functions to deliver exceptional customer service and colleague experience, and ensure timely completion, quality, and compliance in teller functions
* Provide feedback and present ideas for improving customer service and colleague experience, and related performance management process and tools
* Perform operational and customer support tasks
* Provide excellent customer service, engage customers in conversations, and build relationships with them
* Manage the schedule and the daily operations of the teller line
* Make decisions and resolve issues related to daily operations of the teller line, under direction of regional banking management
* Leverage interpretation of applicable regulations, policy and procedure requirements, and audit and escalation procedures
* Support customers and employees in resolving or escalating concerns or complaints
* Collaborate and consult with branch employees, colleagues, and mid\-level managers
* Interact directly with customers
* Coach, motivate, and develop a diverse team of direct reports to achieve full potential and meet established business objectives
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for branch operations
* Mentor and guide talent development of direct reports and assist in hiring talent
* This LO position has customer contact and job duties which may include needs assessing and referring those customers interested in a dwelling secured product to a SAFE team member. This position includes assisting customers without taking an application and without offering or negotiating terms of a dwelling secured transaction. Individuals in a LO position also must meet the Loan Originator requirements under Regulation Z (LO) outlined in the job expectations below

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 2\+ years of experience assessing and meeting the needs of customers or helping with issue resolution, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 1\+ years of Leadership experience

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* Leadership skills including the ability to build, develop, and motivate a diverse work team
* Ability to provide strong customer service while listening, eliciting information efficiently, comprehending, and resolving complex customer issues
* Customer service, operations, or financial services management experience within a high volume, fast\-paced and constantly changing environment
* Ability to educate and connect customers to technology and share the value of mobile banking options
* Ability to interact with integrity and professionalism with customers and employees
* Knowledge and understanding of laws and regulations pertaining to the banking industry
* Knowledge and understanding of retail compliance controls, risk management, and loss prevention
* Ability to work effectively under pressure, meet deadlines, exercise independent judgment, and use critical thinking skills
* Relevant military experience including working with military protocol and instructions, enlisted evaluations, officer/leadership reporting
* Relevant military experience including working in personnel benefits management, processing military personnel orders or transitions, wartime readiness operations, human resources or military recruiting
* Cash handling experience

 **Job Expectations:**

* Ability to work a schedule that may include most Saturdays
* Individuals in Loan Originator (LO) positions must meet the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau qualification requirements and comply with related Wells Fargo policies. The LO qualification requirements include meeting applicable financial responsibility, character, general financial fitness, and criminal background standards. A current credit report will be used to assess your financial responsibility and credit fitness. However, a credit score is not included as part of the evaluation. Successful candidates must also meet ongoing regulatory requirements including additional screening, if necessary
* This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship

jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in quota\-carrying cloud or software sales, or consultative account management at a business\-to\-business (B2B) software company.
* Experience working with internal teams and customer stakeholders.
* Experience managing the full sales cycle (e.g., pipeline management, forecasting, reporting).
* Experience managing commercial negotiations and agreements.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with consultative selling to executives, asking insightful, visionary questions, presenting future\-forward proposals, and building multi\-year account strategies and plans.
* Experience supporting large enterprise organizations, expanding existing accounts, securing new customers, and accelerating consumption business.
* Experience qualifying leads and presenting the value proposition of cloud, data, and AI technologies against customers’ strategic business opportunities and challenges. Experience showcasing current technology trends and Google Cloud differentiators.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and partners in project implementation and negotiation.
* Experience with complex agreements structuring, negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements, and supporting multi\-year engagements.
* Demonstrated business and financial acumen.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.



As a Field Sales Representative (FSR) supporting Strategic Accounts, you are a partner, leading the growth strategy for our strategic customers and partners. You will engage customers with consultative value promoting methodology to transform their business. Within a large account team, you'll harness all of Google's assets to support the customers' success. You will be deeply invested in the customers' industry, their engaged environment, technical issues, financial models, and business goals. You’ll leverage experience engaging with executives to establish and build relationships.
  

  

You will drive long\-term business growth by gaining a deep understanding of customers' critical issues and aligning them with Google Cloud's portfolio of solutions. You will lead the end\-to\-end sales process, from initiating customer conversations to orchestrating teams to deliver business commitments and increased consumption. You will advocate the innovative power of our products and solutions to make organizations more productive, collaborative, and mobile.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $118000 \- $171000 (USD) \+ 150% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits

jobs.title: Business Operations
jobs.description:
**About Roger**  

Roger is an AI platform that frees home health clinicians from paperwork so they can focus on what matters: delivering life\-changing care to our most vulnerable elderly patients in the comfort of their homes. Backed by leading healthcare investors like SignalFire, we've powered millions of visits, deployed to thousands of clinicians, and we're just getting started.

**Job Overview**  

We are looking for Business Operations team members to join our early team. This is a role for a sharp, scrappy operator who wants to learn the business by working in it. Depending on company needs, you will be placed in one area of the business, such as customer operations, revenue operations, people operations, or hiring, and own it end to end.


You will work directly with founders and team leads, and there may be opportunities to take on work in other areas over time as the company grows. This is not a narrow role with a rigid playbook. You will figure things out, build systems, and take real ownership of your area.


You need to be genuinely curious, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by the idea that no problem is "not your job."

**What You Might Work On**  

Your focus will shift as the company grows. You may dive into any of these areas:

* **Hiring:** Step in as an interim hiring manager, run interview loops, track the data, and manage agency and recruiter relationships.
* **People Ops:** Own employee onboarding, support HR processes, and help build the systems that keep a growing team running smoothly.
* **Revenue Operations:** Manage our sales tools, clean and maintain CRM data, and set up workflows and automations that make the GTM team faster.
* **Customer and Support Operations:** Partner with our success and support teams on scheduling, tracking, and process improvements, and help investigate customer issues across teams.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Work with engineering, finance, and leadership to unblock projects and keep things moving.
* **Special Projects:** Build dashboards and metrics for the C\-suite, run analyses, and take on whatever high\-priority project comes up next.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Take projects from ambiguous idea to finished result with minimal oversight.
* **Operational Execution:** Keep the details straight: follow\-ups, record\-keeping, and coordination so nothing falls through the cracks.
* **Systems Building:** Spot broken or manual processes and replace them with clean, scalable workflows.
* **Data and Insights:** Build dashboards, track key metrics, and surface insights that help leadership make better decisions.
* **Cross\-Team Partnership:** Work closely with founders and team leads, and be the person people rely on to get things done.
* **Fast Learning:** Quickly pick up new tools, domains, and workflows, including how home health works and where Roger fits into it.

**Requirements:**

* **Experience:** 2\+ years of professional experience, with prior startup experience required. Backgrounds in operations, RevOps, BizOps, customer success, or similar roles are a strong fit.
* **Fast Learner:** Picks up unfamiliar domains, tools, and processes quickly. Healthcare exposure is a plus but not required.
* **Detail Oriented:** Catches the small things others miss, keeps clean records, and takes pride in precision.
* **Strong Communicator:** Clear, warm, and professional with teammates, candidates, customers, and leadership.
* **Data Comfortable:** Able to work in dashboards, CRMs, and spreadsheets, and use data to spot opportunities.
* **Startup Generalist:** Comfortable with ambiguity, motivated by mission, and energized by ownership in a fast\-paced environment. Eager to jump into any part of the business and execute well.

**Why Join Us?**  

Platinum health, dental, and vision insurance  

Unlimited PTO  

Retirement: 401(k) plan  

Unmatched career growth as an early hire, with exposure to every part of the business  

Work on a mission that matters, backed by AI innovation and top\-tier investors

**Make a Real Difference \- Hear from our Users:**  

"If I had to give Roger a rating out of 10, I'd give it an 11! You guys changed my life!!" \- G.M. from San Francisco, Registered Nurse  

"Roger AI saves me hours per day. I can easily focus on my patients now too." \- J.L. from Tucson, Registered Nurse  

"Being a single mom is tough, but with Roger I can take the time to go to my daughter's soccer game and also pursue further education." \- T.M. from Dallas, Licensed Vocational Nurse


Compensation Range: $110K \- $160K

San Francisco, CA


At Rothy’s, we know there’s a better way to do business, and it starts by putting the planet and its people first. More than 225 million single\-use plastic bottles and 715,000 pounds of ocean\-bound marine plastic have been transformed into our signature thread, creating wardrobe staples that look just as good as they feel.


Striving for zero waste, we combine 3D knitting technology and handcrafted assembly to create machine washable styles that don’t compromise on comfort. From classic shoes to carry\-everywhere bags, we create essentials for wherever you go.


At Rothy’s, building a sustainable future is at the heart of everything we do. We pride ourselves on fostering an inclusive environment at our HQ, retail stores and wholly\-owned factory, and are growing our community every day.

===============================================

**Job Description**
-------------------


In order to be considered for this position candidate must be serving permanently in the title, or reachable on the civil service list, exam \# 3027\.
  

  

Transportation Planning and Management (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, curb management, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  

  

The Office of Livable Streets (OLS) is tasked with prioritizing strategic planning, community engagement, research, policy, design, implementation, and long\-term management. Their goal is to create streets that are livable, supporting safety, accessibility, inclusion, resiliency, active modes, community cohesion, and economic vitality citywide. Additionally, they aim to enhance New York City's pedestrian, bicycle, and micromobility networks, providing comfortable, connected, green, and reliable transportation options across the five boroughs. They place special emphasis on Priority Investment Areas, mode shift, and reimagining streets. The office also develops innovative new programs, design typologies, project delivery, and analysis tools to meet the demands of a rapidly changing population with evolving needs and technologies.
  

  

The NYC DOT Transportation Planning and Management Division (TPM), OLS is seeking a Street Improvement Project (SIP) Coordinator; SIPs involve the use of the agency’s operations teams to implement rapid and meaningful changes to city streets, including Vision Zero safety projects, bus priority projects, bicycle network projects, pedestrian priority projects, among others. The SIP\-Central team within OLS is responsible for organizing and prioritizing an increasingly complex work program across agency. The SIP\-Central team also analyzes and determines implementation capacities to communicate realistic annual work plans; leads coordination with other agencies; and uses database tracking and improving efficiencies to increase output while advancing project quality.
  

  

Under the direction of the Director of Street Improvement Projects, the selected candidate will provide critical support to the Street Improvement Projects (SIP) program by aligning project implementation schedules with resurfacings, traffic signal construction, state of good repair work, and other programs within and external to DOT. The candidate will be responsible for improving efficiency by coordinating with multiple divisions to inform the sequencing of new Street Improvement Projects and upgrades to existing SIPs; they will work independently and collaboratively and be required to manage and reconcile multiple competing priorities. Responsibilities include identifying project overlaps and conflicts, communicating dynamically with various stakeholders, aligning schedules, and pro\-actively advancing implementation priorities across multiple units and agencies.
  

  

The candidate will streamline project delivery by identifying upcoming SIP locations that either overlap with the agency’s scheduled state of good repair work, or where the physical and fiscal integrity of the project would benefit from a resurfacing. The candidate will strategize, prioritize, and track requests to align resurfacing dates with SIP implementations. Working with the Deputy Director of SIPs, the candidate will also manage upcoming SIP locations with signal construction work that overlaps with scheduled resurfacings to inform signal construction priorities and timelines. The candidate will use the SIP Portal, maps and databases to identify existing SIPs scheduled for resurfacing or refurbishment, coordinate with project managers or their delegates to determine treatment changes or upgrades, and work with the Deputy Director to prioritize updates in the design queue. Candidate will coordinate with the Furniture and Operations Unit to plan for temporary furniture relocations related to resurfacings, liaise with internal and external partners on other agency or city\-wide initiatives, and perform additional tasks related to the assigned role as needs arise.
  

  

The Department of Transportation’s (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents. DOT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to recruiting and maintaining a diverse workforce in an open and inclusive environment.

--------------------------

  

  

1\. A master's degree in transportation engineering, mathematics, urban planning, architecture, landscape architecture, urban studies, or related physical and social science fields; or
