As the world’s premier wildlife conservation global organization, WCS has a long track record of achieving innovative, impactful results at scale. If you're committed to making a difference for nature and people, we'd like you to join us! We are a global organization with more than 5,000 diverse and passionate team members operating in nearly 50 countries and spanning across the oceans. We build on a unique foundation: through best\-in\-class science; through work on the ground with local and Indigenous People; through our world\-class zoos, aquarium, and education programs in New York City; and through our partnerships and domestic and international policy work. From field science and conservation policy to non\-profit management and zoo and aquarium operations, the career opportunities at WCS are as diverse as our work. Join WCS team members across the organization as we work to protect nature and the wildlife and people who depend on it.

The Marketing Coordinator will support the execution of integrated marketing initiatives designed to drive attendance, revenue, and brand awareness across WCS’s Zoos and Aquarium. Digital Marketing Support

Design Development Coordinator \- PVH
The Design Development Coordinator drives the product development and commercialization process working with the internal/external cross functional partners (Design, Merch Planning, Raw Materials, Technical Design, Supply, Hub, Factory, Sales and Operations) to deliver product that meets business requirements for quality, aesthetic and price. The Design Development Coordinator establishes consistent communication with the Hub teams /Factories regarding concerns on proper sample execution throughout the development process, and mitigates challenges upfront.

* Work with Design to initiate flash cost request; maintain cost request tracking log for follow up and receipt of costing information from Hub office

* Initiate all sample requests
* Create Line Sheet with images in Visulon for Line Adoption \& Line Finalization milestone meetings
* Work with 3rd party vendor for production of selling tools – swatch card/references
* Partner with RM, QA, and Tech teams to ensure a seasonal risk assessment is complete
* Facilitate \& participate in seasonal product reviews to evaluate sample execution and alignment to tech pack requirements
* Oversee Late Add process and Line Adoption \& Finalization meetings
* Attend fit sessions to review details needed to prepare block/make detail requests
* Initiate and track style development from concept through production, ensuring all approvals are met per calendar deadlines
* Responsible for all daily communication with overseas offices
* Drive product development calendar adherence
* Build effective relationships with internal partners in Design, Sales, Merchandise Planning, and Supply and Operations to help execute cross functional synergy and collaboration
  

  

**What You'll Bring:**

  

  

* 1\-3 years’ experience recommended in product development, merchandising or other related work experience
* Strong organizational skills
* Strong sense of teamwork and ability to multitask
* Work independently
* Excellent communication skills
* Detail oriented and ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment
* High energy level and must work well under pressure

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator (Part-time)
jobs.description:
**PART\-TIME OPERATIONS COORDINATOR**
**SUMMER SEARCH, NEW YORK CITY**
At Summer Search, we believe in 'No Ceilings' and envision a world in which young people, regardless of circumstances, can chart their own destiny. In the United States, students from underserved communities – disproportionately BIPOC and first\-generation – face systemic inequities in school, in the workforce, and in life. Nevertheless, these young people possess unique strengths, resilience, and limitless potential.
Since 1990, Summer Search has partnered with young people during their transition from adolescence into adulthood by connecting them to expansive opportunities, professional mentoring, and a community of support. Summer Searchers recognize their potential and build a toolkit to navigate and challenge systemic barriers, break new ground for their families and communities, and achieve economic equity and a life of purpose.
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
The Part\-Time Operations Coordinator is responsible for the behind\-the\-scenes operations magic that ensures the NYC office is welcoming, well\-maintained, organized, and adequately supplied to support staff, mentoring, and program activities. This is a hands\-on role focused on day\-to\-day office operations, purchasing, inventory, and coordination. Reporting to the NYC Executive Director, this hire will join a collaborative and mission\-driven team of 18 Summer Search NYC staff. This is a part\-time role at 20 hours per week.
**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
*Office Operations and Environment*
* Maintain a welcoming, clean, organized, and functional office environment.
* Serve as the primary point person for day\-to\-day office needs during afternoon hours.
* Monitor office conditions and coordinate with building management, vendors, or service providers when issues arise.
* Ensure common areas, meeting spaces, kitchens, and supplies are ready for staff and visitors.
* Support basic office setup and breakdown for meetings, staff gatherings, and program activities.

*Inventory and Purchasing*
* Maintain inventory of office supplies, snacks, beverages, and other commonly used materials.
* Monitor inventory levels and proactively identify upcoming needs.
* Oversee purchasing and replenishment within established budgets and purchasing processes.
* Purchase and organize supplies needed for group mentoring sessions and summer experiences, including snacks, materials, and equipment.
* Maintain organized storage systems so staff can easily locate materials.
* Track spending and maintain basic purchasing records.

*Program \& Staff Support*
* Ensure teams have the supplies and materials they need for in\-person activities.
* Support purchasing, organizing, and storing equipment and supplies needs for summer experience preparation.
* Provide basic logistical support for staff meetings and events held in the office.

*Office Systems and Coordination*
* Maintain simple systems for inventory, purchasing, and office requests.
* Establish regular routines for checking supplies, placing orders, and maintaining shared spaces.
* Identify recurring office needs and recommend practical improvements.


**WHO YOU ARE**
Specifically, this hire will bring:
* **EXPERIENCE:** At least 2 years of applicable experience in operations, administrative work, or office management, preferably with experience in inventory management. Skill in operations and past success in continuously improving systems/ processes. Experience at a non\-profit is a plus.
* **ACCOUNTABILITY:** You hold yourself and others responsible for processes, decisions, actions, and commitments to results to drive high\-quality outcomes. You're responsive to the needs of stakeholders and follow through on commitments.
* **TEAMWORK AND COLLABORATION:** You value many voices, are comfortable creating space for dialogue and handle interpersonal issues constructively. You inspire and foster commitment, connection, enthusiasm and trust and motivate others to achieve common goals.
* **COMMUNICATION EFFECTIVENESS:** You are an active listener and thoughtful and strategic when conveying feedback, sharing ideas, or responding to inquiries to various audiences in multiple formats.
* **PROJECT MANAGEMENT:** You take initiative to create systems and structures to achieve goals and objectives. You succeed at managing multiple workstreams and motivating, coordinating, and directing others to stay on track.
* **TECHNOLOGY SKILLS:** Strong technology skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office, database systems, virtual meeting platforms, and the ability to quickly learn and troubleshoot new organizational systems and tools.
* **LANGUAGE SKILLS:** Spanish language skills are a plus.

In addition, all Summer Search staff bring a commitment to our mission of unleashing students’ potential through mentoring and transformative experiences, as well as the ability to thrive in an environment that values excellence, gratitude, well\-being, diversity, authenticity, and collaboration.

**LOCATION AND SCHEDULE**
This is a part\-time, in\-person position at the Summer Search NYC office in Manhattan. Hours are Monday through Thursday, 1:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. Additional hours may be requested as needed to support organizational events, with advance approval.
**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**
Competitive and transparent salaries. This is a non\-exempt position with a starting hourly pay rate of $41/hour (20 hours per week). Summer Search is committed to transparent, equitable compensation practices. Salaries are benchmarked using current market data.
Well\-being, flexibility, and ongoing learning and development are pillars of our culture. We value our staff and are committed to creating an environment where every individual feels seen, heard and valued. Investments in our part\-time staff include:
* Generous time off: This 20 hour a week position accrues the following annually: 7\.5 vacation days, 5 sick days, a birthday day\-off, and one flex holiday.
* Paid holiday

jobs.description:
**About Us:**

  

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

  

**Exciting Opportunity at MSK:** We are seeking a French\-speaking Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) to join the Immigrant Health \& Cancer Disparities team.

  

  

This role supports Health Fairs through the Taxi Network Initiative. This team conducts community\-based participatory research to reduce health disparities and investigate varying health concerns among NYC taxi drivers. The CRCs assist with the maintenance of participant management and data management on research/clinical studies.

  

  

**Role Overview:**

* Lead participant recruitment and outreach by attending health fairs at taxi garages, conducting interviews, and guiding individuals through the study enrollment and consent process
* Assist the study RN with finger sticks and enter participant data accurately into the system
* Support data collection using appropriate methodologies to gather human subject information for research protocols and/or clinical trials, including assisting with patient recruitment and maintaining study databases within specified timelines
* Generate and distribute data reports to key stakeholders on study progress
* Ensure compliance with all applicable institutional, state, and federal regulations; maintain IRB approvals and complete required regulatory documentation
* Provide clerical and administrative support, including filing, organizing study materials, and participating in study meetings as needed
  

  

**Key Qualifications:**

* Fluency in written and spoken French is required (a language assessment will be part of the interview process)
* A genuine interest in working in health disparities research
* Experience in the healthcare setting or a community engagement role is preferred
* Experience using data entry tools like REDCap is a plus
  

  

**Core Skills:**

* **Interpersonal skills:** Strong ability to build rapport and communicate effectively with individuals who may be unfamiliar with research participation.
* **Decision\-making:** Demonstrated success in making timely, effective decisions that support organizational progress.
* **Accountability:** Strong sense of personal responsibility, with the ability to hold yourself and others accountable to achieve results.
* **Adaptability:** Flexible in approach and demeanor, able to adjust to shifting priorities and evolving circumstances.
* **Data proficiency:** Comfortable working with or eager to learn how to manage and organize large amounts of data.
  

  

**Additional Information:**

* **Hours:** Most days are Monday \- Friday, 9 am \- 5 pm (hybrid schedule, 4 days onsite/week, up to 5 days depending on need). **Flexibility is required to work evening shifts approximately 4 days per month from 12 pm \- 8 pm, and 1 Sunday per month from 12 pm \- 8 pm.**

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
As a Zuma Event Operations Manager, you are responsible for the seamless operational execution of private events and special functions at Zuma, overseeing each event from pre\-event preparation through on\-site execution and post\-event follow\-up. Working closely with Events Sales, restaurant management, culinary teams, and other departments, this role ensures the highest standards of service for a discerning, often high\-profile clientele while supporting daily restaurant operations as a Floor Manager when event volume permits.

  

Zuma is a contemporary Japanese restaurant collection, inspired by the dynamic Izakaya dining style. Our global collection includes four venues across North America's most iconic cities: Miami, New York, Las Vegas, and Boston. Our venues are icons in each of their hospitality landscapes, demonstrating our commitment to excellence and to elevating our guest experiences. Zuma in proud to be part of the Azumi collection.

 **Life at Zuma**


At Zuma, we're more than a restaurant – we're a vibrant community fuelled by the energy that flows from our Robata grills, guided by our core values:

**Honor the Mastery** \- we celebrate every detail, always striving for perfection – putting pride in everything we do

**Do Unto Others** \- we support each other to be at our best, treating every team member and guest with warmth and openness

**Embrace the Energy** \- we bring passion and positivity to everything we do

 **Main Duties**


Your key responsibilities will include:

* Lead the operational execution of private events, buyouts, and special functions from setup through breakdown, ensuring all details meet client expectations and Zuma standards
* Review BEOs, floor plans, menus, timelines, guest profiles, and special requests in advance to ensure operational readiness
* Partner closely with the Events Sales team to transition confirmed events from planning into seamless operational execution
* Coordinate with FOH, Culinary, Bar, Sommelier, Facilities, and other departments to align staffing, setup, service requirements, and event timelines
* Lead pre\-event briefings and provide direction to service teams, ensuring clear understanding of event details, VIPs, service expectations, timing, and individual responsibilities
* Oversee event setup, including room configuration, table arrangements, service stations, equipment, and other operational requirements
* Manage event service in real time, monitoring timing, service flow, food and beverage execution, and overall presentation while proactively resolving operational challenges
* Responsible to accurately ring in all event sales in accordance to event contract into the POS and ensure proper financial SOPs are upheld
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact during events, coordinating with event hosts and internal teams to accommodate requests and changes as needed
* Manage high\-profile and VIP events with professionalism, discretion, and careful attention to guest preferences and special requirements
* Conduct post\-event reviews and identify opportunities to improve event procedures, service standards, training, and overall execution
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of the restaurant’s private dining spaces, capacities, layouts, menus, and operational capabilities
* Support daily restaurant operations as a Floor Manager when event volume permits, including overseeing service, supporting the FOH team, and addressing guest needs

 **What We Look For**


Our ideal candidate embodies our values and the following:

* 3\+ years of progressive restaurant or event operations management experience, preferably within high\-volume, luxury or premium dining, hotels, or event\-driven hospitality environments
* Strong understanding of luxury restaurant operations, elevated service standards, and event execution
* Proven ability to interpret BEOs, floor plans, event timelines, and detailed operational requirements
* Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to effectively coordinate teams across multiple departments and interact professionally with guests
* Exceptional organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple events and competing priorities simultaneously
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to anticipate challenges and make effective decisions in high\-pressure environments
* Ability to manage multiple events and competing priorities simultaneously
* Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as required

 **Benefits**


We offer incredible career growth, international opportunities, and the chance to contribute to a world\-renowned brand, where every detail from the finest ingredients to our unrivalled atmosphere is crafted to perfection.


As part of our team, you’ll enjoy:

* **World\-Class training,** designed to inspire and educate
* **Global opportunities**, experience hospitality around the globe with our five incredible brands
* **Health Benefits:** Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance to ensure your well\-being
* **Bonus Opportunity**, eligible roles may participate in our annual bonus program, rewarding individual and business performance
* **401(k) Retirement Plan,** supporting your long\-term financial well\-being and future goals
* **Family Meals** are shared daily
* **Rewards \& Recognition,** we value our team and celebrate your contributions to our success with meaningful rewards and recognition
* **Staff discount,** enjoy exclusive discounts across the Azumi group, worldwide!

 **Our Commitment to Inclusivity**


We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome all applicants. If you require any assistance to make the recruitment process more accessible, please let one of our Talent Acquisition team know.

jobs.title: Account Executive / Account Manager, Data Sales at Kalshi
jobs.description:
**What is Kalshi?**
-------------------


Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.


We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

* Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.
* Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.


Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

**Role Roadmap**
----------------


We’re looking for an Account Executive / Account Manager to grow Kalshi’s institutional market data business.


You’ll sell Kalshi’s event contract prices, order book data, and historical datasets to hedge funds, asset managers, banks, proprietary trading firms, quantitative investment teams, and fintech companies. You’ll help customers understand how prediction market data can support research, trading strategies, risk management, and financial products.


This role combines new business development with ongoing account ownership. You’ll build pipeline from scratch, run deals from initial outreach through signed contracts, and grow the relationships you bring in. You should be as comfortable discussing a dataset with a quantitative researcher as negotiating a licensing agreement with procurement.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Identify and win new institutional customers for Kalshi’s market data through targeted outbound prospecting, industry relationships, and your existing network.
* Own the full sales cycle, including discovery, product demonstrations, data evaluations, commercial proposals, negotiations, and closing.
* Translate customer needs into clear use cases for event contract prices, order book data, and historical datasets.
* Work directly with quants, portfolio managers, traders, and data engineers to explain data coverage, delivery methods, and integration requirements.
* Structure and negotiate API, data feed, and licensing agreements in partnership with Legal and relevant internal teams.
* Coordinate with Product and Engineering to support customer evaluations, onboarding, and technical integrations.
* Own ongoing account relationships, driving adoption, renewals, and expansion across teams and use cases.
* Maintain a disciplined sales pipeline, accurate forecasts, and clear visibility into customer needs and commercial opportunities.
* Bring customer feedback into decisions about data products, packaging, pricing, and distribution.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in institutional financial or market data sales or account management.
* A track record of selling to hedge funds, asset managers, banks, proprietary and quantitative trading firms, or fintech companies.
* A hunter mentality: you create opportunities, build pipeline from zero, and take responsibility for getting deals across the finish line.
* Experience selling APIs, data feeds, and data licenses, with an understanding of how institutions evaluate, procure, and consume financial data.
* Fluency in market structure, including exchange mechanics, order books, liquidity, price formation, and how market data supports institutional workflows.
* The ability to hold credible technical and commercial conversations with quantitative researchers, data engineers, investment professionals, and procurement teams.
* Strong negotiation and relationship management skills, with evidence of closing new business and growing existing accounts.
* Comfort working in an environment where you’ll help build the sales process while executing it.
* Willingness to work in person from our New York office  

You’ve got that dawg in you.
  

  

**Especially valuable:**
* A CFA designation or comparable credential demonstrating depth in financial markets.
* Experience at an enterprise financial data provider, exchange data business, or emerging market data vendor.
* An established network of institutional data buyers.
* Institutional sales experience at a crypto or derivatives exchange, or familiarity with prediction markets.  

  

Base salary range: 100k\+ Annually plus equity and benefits

**Our Culture**
---------------


Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.


Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1\.

**Commitment to Equal Opportunity**
-----------------------------------


Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

You will serve as the primary owner of a set book of existing employer partners, working closely with them to ensure they achieve their goals, build relationships with executives, and drive customer retention and expansion from onboarding through renewal.

* Learn your book of business inside and out to effectively position Handshake’s value proposition, always linking it back to key business issues of the customer

* Partner closely with our Employer Customer Success Team to ensure customers adopt and are successful on Handshake
* Manage and present data and value\-driven Quarterly Business Reviews
* Enlist and inspire customers to participate in Handshake events and other marketing materials
* Manage overall customer loyalty, serving as internal advocate and escalation point to customers
* Assist in identifying and developing scalable account management tools and methodologies that can be applied across the Account Management team  

Help scale internal process to support hundreds of premium employers
* Becoming a Handshake expert, learning the ins and outs of HR and higher ed Tech

 *Must be willing to work onsite from our SF or NY office\- expected 5 days a week.*  

*Must be willing to travel as needed for customer engagements.*

**You Have**

* At least 2\+ years of sales experience in Enterprise SaaS sales or Account Management, 5\+ years in a closing and quota carrying role
* Experience preparing renewal proposals, forecasting, and account planning
* A strong history of quota attainment and excellent performance on a high\-reaching team  

Experience with an evangelical sale, selling non\-discretionary software to executives at Fortune 1000 companies
* Experience managing customer relationships alongside a Customer Success team

jobs.description:
**Trustpair stops vendor fraud before it happens.** We're the automated vendor validation platform protecting 600\+ enterprise companies worldwide. Since 2017, finance and procurement teams have used Trustpair to eliminate vendor fraud while reclaiming 90% of the time they once spent on manual checks.


As vendor fraud grows more sophisticated, we stay ahead by combining deep expertise in financial crime with cutting\-edge technology. AI isn't a buzzword here, it's embedded in everything we do. From your first week, you'll use AI tools to accelerate your impact, with dedicated training and peer support to help you master them. Our teams have embedded AI into daily work, from automating routine tasks to unlocking strategic insights. The result? Work that used to take hours now takes minutes, and you'll spend more time on what matters.


With offices in New York, Paris, London, and Milan, we're a diverse team united by a bias for action. We ship fast, learn from experiments, and tackle problems that matter: protecting billions in payments for companies worldwide. If you want to see your work make an immediate impact in financial security, Trustpair is built for you.

**Learn more about** **how we use AI in our everyday work****.**

### **About the role**


Trustpair is hiring a **Customer Success Manager** to join our **US team** and own a portfolio of **enterprise** customer accounts.


As the main point of contact for your customers, you will build trusted relationships with stakeholders such as Accounts Payable Managers and Finance Directors. You will guide customers through onboarding, adoption, retention and advocacy, with Account Management support on renewals and growth opportunities.


You will join **Caitlin Sweeney**'s team, initially reporting to our **VP of Customer Success**. This is an individual contributor role with responsibility for your own portfolio and support from experienced colleagues across the business.


Your success will be measured through gross retention, expansion ARR, NPS, CSAT, and product adoption and consumption.

**Location**: New York City, with 2\-3 days per week in our NYC office.

**Compensation**: $125,000 annual base salary plus a $10,000 annual bonus.

**Preferred start**: By November 2026\.

### **What you'll do**

* **Build proactive customer relationships.** Establish regular contact, understand each customer's priorities and tailor your communication so that every account receives the right level of attention.
* **Own onboarding and adoption.** Lead or co\-lead onboarding, agree on success measures with customers, and use product usage data to track progress. Take action when adoption falls behind.
* **Identify and address churn risk.** Monitor account health, engagement and stakeholder changes. Develop recovery plans and coordinate internal support before issues become escalations.
* **Support renewals and account growth.** Connect customer outcomes to renewal readiness, identify expansion opportunities and partner with Account Managers on commercial discussions. Help satisfied customers become advocates.
* **Make product conversations clear.** Learn how Trustpair works and explain features, limitations and technical issues in terms customers understand. Bring in specialists when needed and keep customers informed throughout.
* **Manage your portfolio with discipline.** Prioritize accounts using health signals, maintain accurate records and follow through on commitments across multiple customer lifecycle stages.
* **Bring customer insight into the business.** Share feedback with Product, Implementation and other teams to improve the customer experience and how we work.

### **What’s in it for you**

* At Trustpair, we see AI as a tool to save time, sharpen focus, and boost impact. Whether you're already hands\-on with AI or eager to learn, you’ll join a team that values and encourages AI\-driven ways of working.
* A role with visible impact on customer retention, growth and protection against vendor payment fraud.
* Structured onboarding and manager support, with a target of taking ownership of your first account within 45 days.
* The opportunity to build your commercial judgment and product knowledge alongside experienced colleagues.

### **Why join Trustpair? A list of our perks** **here****!**

For a long time, **Farsight has been best\-in\-class at deliverables generation and iteration**. Unlike general AI finance platforms that focus primarily on research, Farsight has spent years focused on producing high\-quality, personalized end deliverables. This has given us a meaningful advantage in capturing judgment data: the comments, edits, and nuances a partner makes on a deck or model as it travels from first draft to final version.


Our platform enables teams to deliver full client\-ready documents natively in Microsoft Office Suite (slide decks, CIMs, financial models, memos) end\-to\-end. By using your firm’s historical best practices and voice there are no generic outputs. Everything is aligned to your brand.


Security, scale, and precision matter. We operate with SOC\-2 compliance, full end\-to\-end encryption, and deployment options from customer\-cloud to on\-premise.

One of the fastest\-growing platforms for financial advisors, driven by product\-led growth  

Recognized by users as a top\-rated investment solution on G2

Koyfin has over 60,000 financial advisors using the platform and over 800,000 registered users. Most of them found us on their own. You'll be one of our first in\-house SDRs, joining a lean sales org. You own the human side of outreach: research, calls, and LinkedIn. You'll run time\-boxed tests across a 45\-day multi\-touch journey of calls, emails, and LinkedIn.

jobs.description:
**Description**


Join Syneos Health in partnership with a large Biopharmaceutical company as a Pharmaceutical Sales Representative (PSR). Become a part of a fast\-paced and challenging environment where our compassion and dedication drive us to meet the unique needs and goals of our customers. The PSR role is responsible for building relationships with recognized experts, healthcare providers (HCPs) and prioritized stakeholders.

**The successful PSR will:**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing, and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key accounts with the goal of maximizing sales
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action
* Deliver clinical brand specific presentations of product(s) to physicians and other appropriate health care professionals
* Develop a complete understanding of the health care delivery system within each assigned customer, including the physician hierarchy, key pharmacy personnel, clinical nursing staff, etc.
* Develop deep product and competitor knowledge and understanding of local and regional market trends
* Analyze local trends, identifying long and short\-term goals to craft a strong product business plan
* Collaborate and partner with peers in the sales organization, brand team and other support partners to deliver an extraordinary customer experience
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner
* Execute the company brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area
* Participation in training and development programs
* Leverage AI\-driven insights and digital engagement tools to personalize healthcare provider interactions and improve customer experience.
* Adapt to emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and automation tools, to enhance productivity, customer engagement, and business outcomes.
* Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate, industry policies and procedures

**Essential Requirements:**

* BA/BS degree required, Life Sciences preferred
* Business to business sales experience or internship experience and/or sales degree or 2\+ years of pharmaceutical experience
* Ability to identify key decision makers, develop positive relationships and strong customer dedication and influence prescribing habits
* Ability to learn, apply, and communicate products and disease states
* Proven track record of success in exceeding results
* Team player who can also work independently, highly collaborative and motivated to succeed
* Strong communication, business analytics and account management skills
* Strong digital acumen with an interest in adopting innovative technologies, including artificial intelligence, to drive performance and operational efficiency.

**Desired Requirements:**

* Cardiovascular Experience


The annual base salary for this position is **$60,000 – $90,000**. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include a company car or car allowance and eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and/or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you’re empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*


At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

* Smart and confident to build successful client relationships and overcome objections/rejections over the phone

jobs.description:
**Operations Assistant**  
***New York, Manhattan \| Full\-time \| On\-site \| $26–$28 per hour***

Well\-run consulting work depends on the information moving between teams: the right meeting materials, an up\-to\-date schedule, and a clear record of decisions. We are looking for an Operations Assistant to help keep those internal processes working across our New York office. You will support managers and colleagues as they plan meetings, share updates, and organize the day\-to\-day work behind client engagements.

This is a full\-time, on\-site position offers practical exposure to business operations and consulting in a role where accuracy and initiative make a visible difference. You will learn how different teams work together while building skills in coordination, documentation, and process improvement.

Where you will contribute

**Keep information moving**

* Maintain shared calendars, internal trackers, and contact lists so teams are working from current information.
* Follow up with colleagues for missing updates and bring changes or conflicting details to a manager’s attention.
* Prepare concise internal summaries of meeting actions and outstanding requests.

**Make meetings productive**

* Coordinate meeting times, rooms, invitations, and materials for managers and internal teams.
* Assemble agendas and supporting documents, check that materials are complete, and distribute approved versions.
* Record agreed next steps and help the people responsible keep track of them.

**Support consistent office processes**

* Organize digital files using clear names and version control.
* Enter and review information in spreadsheets and office systems, correcting errors where appropriate.
* Help document recurring procedures and suggest simple improvements when a process causes avoidable delays.
* Work with administrative, consulting, and leadership colleagues on requests that require input from more than one team.

What makes someone effective in this role

You can bring order to several moving tasks without losing sight of the details. You write clearly, communicate professionally, and follow through when you say you will. You are comfortable asking questions, handling confidential information with care, and adapting when a priority changes.

Confidence with email, calendars, documents, and spreadsheets is important. Prior operations or office experience is helpful, but consulting experience and a degree are not required.

The Operations Assistant role suits someone who enjoys helping colleagues work effectively and wants to develop a broader understanding of how a business runs. Apply with your current resume to be considered.

* 401(k)

jobs.title: Victim Witness Asst Program Coordinator (SEE POLICE-SPECIFIC DESCRIPTION BELOW SUPPLEMENTAL)
jobs.description:
**Salary Range: $22\.33 \- $35\.84/Hour (FLSA Non Exempt)**

Essential Functions:


*The following duties are normal for this position. The omission of specific statements of the duties does not exclude them from the classification if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment for this classification. Other duties may be required and assigned.*

Provides assistance to victims of misdemeanor crimes; contacts victim by phone, letter or field visits; completes intake forms; determines and evaluates victim experiences and needs; makes referrals and recommendations regarding counseling, safety needs and concerns, housing, food and other needs; explains and provides information and assistance regarding criminal justice processes, what to expect in their particular cases, victim's rights, victim notification of custody status changes and case information, temporary protective orders, bond conditions, compensation and restitution programs and individualized safety plans; remains in contact with the victim throughout their case and provides updates and support; and provides crisis intervention as needed.


Evaluates cases and offers appropriate recommendations; reviews police reports, 911 calls, pictures, medical records, criminal histories, etc.; gathers additional information as needed; compiles and submits data on high risk defendants to appropriate law enforcement and judicial agencies; assesses cases and make recommendations to prosecutors and investigators regarding case dispositions, victim's desires, defendant's criminal history, lethality factors, etc.; and refers cases as required by law to Department of Family and Children Services and Adult Protective Services.


Assists as a liaison between the prosecution teams and the victims; schedules and attends field visits to interview victims with prosecutors and investigators; collaborates with prosecutors to ensure the victims voices are heard throughout the pendency of the case; relays victim information and requests to the prosecutors; assists prosecutors and investigators with necessary follow\-up questions; communicates with the District Attorney’s Office on cases pending which involve the same parties; assists with addressing and transportation or safety issues; assists with preparing the victims to face and testify against their abuser in court; and advises prosecutors of any violations of bond, Temporary Protective Orders or potential escalation of danger to the victim.


Attends court sessions and provides support to the victim during court proceedings; accompanies victims to all court proceedings; contacts victims should a court appearance be missed; conducts a welfare check as needed; and ensures all protective measures have been taken within the courtroom to maintain the victim's safety.


Performs community outreach; participates in community\-based initiatives; provides information and education on issues related to domestic violence, violent crimes, victim assistance and related issues to the public, law enforcement, and others; serves on a variety of committees and task forces; and builds and maintains relationships with community officers and community\-based advocates to coordinate services for mutual clients.


Performs administrative duties in compliance with established local, state and federal laws; maintains victim information in case management system for statistical and communication purposes; prepares and sends various letters relating to the status of the case; prepares and submits various reports; and retrieves necessary documents for incident review.


Minimum Qualifications:


Associate's Degree in Social Work or related field required; two years of experience in criminal justice, law enforcement, social justice, or related field; or any equivalent combination of education, training, and experience which provides the requisite knowledge, skills, and abilities for this job.


**Specific License or Certification Required:** Must possess and maintain a valid Georgia driver’s license.  



**Supplemental**

POLICE\-SPECIFIC POSITION


Purpose of Classification:


The purpose of this classification is to coordinate programs and services for victims and witnesses of misdemeanor and felony crimes and to provide guidance and support throughout the investigative process.


Essential Functions:


*The following duties are normal for this position. The omission of specific statements of the duties does not exclude them from the classification if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment for this classification. Other duties may be required and assigned.*

Provides advocacy to victims of misdemeanor, violent and felony crimes; contacts victims by phone, letter or field visits to determine and evaluate victim experiences and needs; and prepares victims for interviews by discussing what to expect in their particular case.


Responds to callouts of significant traumatic scenes where immediate advocacy and involvement is critical; assists as a liaison between detectives and victims; and relays victim information and requests to detectives.


Plans and coordinates for communication between stakeholders; schedules time to address each victim and the approprite associated parties; provides list of resources available to victims; and makes referral and recommendations regarding counseling, safety needs and concerns, housing, food and other resources.


Attends meetings held on behalf of victims with associated parties; meets with victims via phone or in\-person to assess each case; fills in for victims in meetings when applicable; and explains the legal process, i.e., court proceedings.


Provides support and/or transportation for victims for scheduled interviews and court proceedings; attends court sessions and provides support to victims during court proceedings; contacts victims if a court appearance is missed; and follows up with victims to determine if assistance is required on non\-critical cases.

jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Doka USA is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place to Work®!** We are committed to fostering a supportive work environment where all of our team members can thrive. As one of the world’s leading companies for developing, manufacturing, and distributing formwork solutions for the construction sector, Doka employs more than 9,000 people in over 58 countries and is part of the family\-owned Umdasch Group.

**We Make It Work.**

 **Job Description** **Summary of Position**  

  

We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented **Junior Account Manager** to support our sales and account management efforts in the formwork and shoring industry. This individual will play a key role in building and maintaining client relationships, assisting in the sales process, and ensuring customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate will have strong communication skills, a proactive attitude, and a desire to grow within the company.

**Responsibilities**

* Assist in managing a portfolio of clients, maintaining regular communication, and ensuring their needs are met.

* Collaborate with senior account managers to prepare and deliver accurate proposals, quotes, and project timelines.
* Identify opportunities to upsell products and services that enhance project outcomes.
* Coordinate with internal teams, including engineering, logistics, and field services, to ensure smooth execution of client projects.
* Track and manage project timelines, ensuring materials and services are delivered on schedule.
* Conduct market research to stay informed on industry trends, competitor offerings, and client developments.
* Identify potential new business opportunities within the assigned region or client base.
* Maintain accurate client records in the CRM system, including project updates, communications, and sales forecasts.
* Prepare reports for management on account activities, sales performance, and client feedback.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 1\-2 years of experience in sales support, account management, or customer service, preferably within the construction or formwork and shoring industry.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a customer\-focused mindset.
* Proficiency in CRM tools and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with attention to detail and the ability to meet deadlines.
* Willingness to travel to job sites and client meetings as needed.
* Knowledge of formwork, shoring, or scaffolding systems and related construction processes.
* Experience reading construction blueprints and technical drawings.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.

  

**Additional Information**  

Doka offers terrific career opportunities, competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Account, company paid life insurance, supplemental voluntary term life insurance, 401k retirement plan (Roth and Non\-Roth), short\-term disability, AFLAC policies, paid time off (sick/personal, vacation, floating holiday and company paid holidays) and an exciting opportunity to join as a member of Doka's team.

Doka USA, Ltd. is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

* Demonstrated track record of achieving performance goals and growing an assigned sales territory.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to develop and deliver effective presentations to audiences at all levels of an organization.
* Valid driver's license and a clean driving record required.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Knowledge of Snap\-on products, services, and programs is preferred.

If you’re looking to join a sales force who works directly for the manufacturer, want to work with a variety of industries, and have the ability to make your own schedule, please apply today!

  

Snap\-on is a drug free work environment and welcomes all qualified candidates to apply. Local candidates are strongly encouraged to apply since we are not offering relocation assistance at this time.

Ceribell is a medical technology company focused on transforming the diagnosis and management of patients with serious neurological conditions. The Ceribell System is a novel, point\-of\-care electroencephalography ("EEG") platform specifically designed to address the unmet needs of patients in the acute care setting, and is being used in hundreds of community hospitals, large academic facilities and major IDN's across the country. The Strategic Account Manager plays a critical role in driving Ceribell's growth across key regional IDNs, academic medical centers, and large health systems. This individual contributor position focuses on securing system\-wide adoption and expanding utilization of Ceribell's rapid EEG technology across multiple care settings.

jobs.title: Personal Lines Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:** The **Personal Lines Insurance Account Manager** will be responsible for managing a book of insurance business, marketing new and renewal business, and rounding out client accounts. In addition to client relationships, an Account Manager also maintains positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.


**Supervisory Responsibilities:** None


**Essential Tasks:**


* Assisting the Personal Lines Sales Producer in maintaining the client's insurance policies
* Preparing endorsements to send to the insurance carriers
* Assisting with cancellations of policies
* Educates clients about coverages and make recommendations as needed to meet client insurance needs
* Handles renewals and remarkets as needed. Develop proposals and may present to clients.
* Handles or refers insured’s questions or delegates to appropriate team member
* Actively refers clients to Benefits and Commercial Lines departments for solicitation of new business
* Maintains detailed customer records in the agency management systems (Applied EPIC and CSR 24\)
* Maintains healthy working relationship with underwriters, carriers and other stakeholders
* On occasion, may work with Accounting Department to reconcile accounting discrepancies
* Keeps informed regarding industry information, new product information, coverages, and technology to continuously improve knowledge and stay current


**Core Competencies:**

* Ability to Analyze and Solve Problems: Skill in recognizing challenges, exploring options, and implementing effective solutions in a timely manner
* Attention to Detail: A strong focus on completing tasks and projects accurately and thoroughly
* Communication Skills: Capable of expressing ideas clearly in both verbal and written forms and engaging with various audiences
* Timely Task Completion: Ability to finish tasks and projects efficiently, managing resources and priorities effectively
* Team Collaboration: Willingness to work together with others, promoting teamwork and supporting shared goals
* Client Focus: Dedication to understanding and addressing the needs of clients and stakeholders to ensure their satisfaction
* Dependability: Acknowledgment of the importance of being present and punctual.
* Creative Thinking: Openness to suggesting new ideas and methods to improve processes and outcome
* Organizational Skills: Capability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Adaptability: Willingness to adjust to changing situations and priorities, showing resilience in a dynamic work environment


**Experience and Education:**


* 3\-5 years of Personal Line Insurance experience required
* Experience with high net worth clients is a plus


**Licensing and Credentials:**


* Active General Lines or Property \& Casualty License required
* Designations preferred (i.e CISR, CIC, CPRIA)


**Systems:**


* Proficient with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
* Applied Epic experience preferred, but knowledge of similar Account Management System (AMS) is acceptable


**Physical Requirements:**


* Ability to lift 25 pounds
* Repeated use of sight to read documents and computer screens
* Repeated use of hearing and speech to communicate on telephone and in person
* Repetitive hand movements, such as keyboarding, writing, 10\-key
* Walking, bending, sitting, reaching and stretching in all directions


**Benefits \& Compensation:**


* Higginbotham offers medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, 401K, equity incentive plan as well as multiple supplemental benefits for physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing.
* Company paid holidays, plus PTO
* Employee wellness program


**Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies:** To protect the interests of all parties, Higginbotham Insurance Agency, Inc., and our partners, will not accept unsolicited potential placements from any source other than directly from the candidate or a vendor partner under MSA with Higginbotham. Please do not contact or send unsolicited potential placements to our team members.


* Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

jobs.title: CONUS IGSA Account Manager - Washington DC
jobs.description:
Gordian is looking for an **Account Manager** based in **Washington DC** who demonstrates professionalism, construction knowledge and delivers results through their expertise while using Gordian’s extraordinary construction data and software. Primary responsibility for Gordian Account Managers is to provide support, training, for products and services centered around Job Order Contracting (JOC) for clients in a specific geographic area. JOC is a procurement method and construction process that helps federal, state and local governments, schools, hospitals, higher education institutions and others maximize efficiency, optimize cost savings, and increase construction quality.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEAO
jobs.description:
**THE COMPANY:**
================


The Low Income Investment Fund is a non\-profit Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) that mobilizes capital and partners to achieve opportunity, equity and wellbeing for people and communities. LIIF innovates financial solutions to create more equitable outcomes for all by building and preserving affordable homes, quality educational opportunities from early childhood through higher education, health clinics, healthy food retail and community facilities. In this way, LIIF provides a bridge between private capital markets and communities. LIIF’s headquarters is in San Francisco and has offices in Los Angeles, New York, Atlanta, and Washington D.C.**POSITION SUMMARY:**
=====================


The Executive Assistant provides administrative support to the Chief External Affairs Officer.**REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS:**
============================


The position reports to the CEAO**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**
========================


The Executive Assistant (EA) provides a broad variety of executive support in a one\-on\-one working relationship, serving as the primary point of contact for internal and external constituencies on all matters pertaining to the Office of the CEAO. Assists in organizing and coordinating retreats, site visits and external relations efforts; supports the CEAO with all travel and expense management and completes special projects as assigned. The EA exercises good judgment and maintains confidentiality and discretion in a variety of situations.  

 ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


 CEAO and General Executive Affairs Departmental Support

* Serves in “gatekeeper” role for internal and external constituencies, consulting with CEAO as needed and using discretion to determine appropriate course of action. Prioritizes conflicting needs while providing a bridge for smooth communication between the CEAO and internal departments; demonstrates leadership to maintain credibility, trust and support with LIIF staff.
* Working with both external and internal contacts, schedules and manages a calendar of calls, videoconferences and in\-person meetings. Maintains CEAO’s contacts in Outlook.
* Works closely and effectively with the CEAO to keep him/her well informed of upcoming commitments and responsibilities, following up appropriately. Works with staff and external constituencies to obtain preparatory materials for CEAO’s review in advance of meetings.
* Attends virtual meetings at the request of the CEAO and takes notes that are distributed to attendees. Ensures that attendees follow up on tasks as assigned.
* Maintains tasks / deliverables in Asana of outstanding CEAO meetings, activities and deliverables.
* Arranges frequent travel, including plane, train and hotel reservations and conference registration. Schedules travel\-related meetings and obtains necessary preparatory materials in advance.
* Coordinates weekly External Affairs team meetings, soliciting agenda items and disseminating agendas and materials in advance of each meeting. Shares notes after meetings.
* Coordinates the completion of expense reports with receipts, in accordance with internal policies.
* Composes written and email correspondence on behalf of CEAO. Maintains electronic files and records. Completes mailings/shipping and obtain office supplies and equipment.
* Completes special projects at the request of the CEAO, which may involve research, analysis, document formatting and recommendations for a course of action. Create PowerPoint presentations as needed. Ability to use Lucid chart for workflows and visualization. Lead e\-signature via Nitro or other platforms to multiple authorized signatories. Maintain delegation hierarchy chart and update if needed.
* Assists in preparing annual department budgets for the Office of the CEAO. Monitors expenditures and reports variances to the CEAO.
* Initiates and executes contracts in Salesforce; coordinates payments to consultants and vendors as approved by CEAO.
* Provides occasional support for other members of the External Affairs team as assigned.
* Works under the supervision of the CEAO on board\-related matters. Coordinates with CEAO and other EA staff on the preparation of materials for all committees and board meetings.
* Coordinate with other EAs for preparing efficiently and on time regarding important meetings and events.
* Identifies ways to streamline company operations and practices for improved productivity and reduced duplication.
**QUALIFICATIONS:**
===================


Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment, with minimal supervision. Ability to adapt to and work effectively in evolving situations and to anticipate executive needs. Must possess a high standard for generating quality work and a positive attitude and demeanor. Must possess strong interpersonal skills and be capable of working both independently and seeking guidance from supervisors for priority setting. In addition, candidates will have advanced\-level skills with Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint; proficiency with Excel and Zoom; and familiarity with databases such as Salesforce and expense management systems like Concur or Expensify. Will possess strong administrative and organizational skills; excellent communication skills, verbal and written; and research experience. The EA will be able to work under pressure and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment; and will be able to handle complex logistical arrangements.**EDUCATIONAL AND OTHER****REQUIREMENTS:**
==========================================


A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required. The candidate must have a minimum of two years of comparable experience supporting a C\-level executive. The position is demanding and requires excellent attendance, self\-motivation, attention to detail, thoroughness, creativity, and a high degree of flexibility. Travel may be required at least once each year, for 2\-3 days each trip. Individual

jobs.title: Sanitation & Food Safety Program Specialist, US
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and highly technical Sanitation \& Food Safety Program Specialist, US to join our growing team!
  
This corporate\-level role is responsible for advancing and standardizing sanitation programs across DO \& CO’s U.S. operations. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on food safety professional who can assess complex production environments, identify sanitation and microbiological risks, lead root\-cause investigations, and translate technical requirements into practical, sustainable solutions.
  
  

About DO \& CO
  
  

We have a passion for hospitality culinary delights on every elevated floor and in the sky. With our three business segments, Airline Catering, International Event Catering, Restaurants, Lounges \& Hotels, we offer gourmet entertainment all over the world. We operate in 33 locations, 12 countries and 3 Continents, maintaining the highest standard of quality in both our products and services. We refine the classics, develop the unknown and grow constantly – sometimes beyond our own expectations.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Provide technical oversight and guidance for sanitation programs across DO \& CO’s U.S. facilities.
* Develop, standardize, and continuously improve SSOPs, Master Sanitation Schedules, cleaning procedures, and verification standards.
* Conduct sanitation assessments across production areas, ready\-to\-eat environments, equipment, coolers, freezers, dishrooms, drains, docks, and waste areas.
* Evaluate cleaning methods, chemicals, concentrations, contact times, equipment, sanitation contractors, and service providers.
* Identify hygienic\-design concerns and sanitation vulnerabilities and partner with facility teams to implement sustainable solutions.
* Establish standardized pre\-operational inspection and release programs across facilities.
* Conduct independent inspections to verify sanitation effectiveness and production readiness.
* Identify food residue, grease, biofilm risks, standing water, damaged surfaces, inaccessible areas, and other sanitation deficiencies
* Ensure corrective actions are completed and effective before equipment or production areas are released for use.
* Maintain consistent documentation, escalation, and follow\-up procedures for significant findings.
* Support the development and continuous improvement of Environmental Monitoring Programs, with particular focus on ready\-to\-eat and high\-risk areas.
* Review sampling plans, locations, frequencies, zoning, ATP results, and environmental trend data.
* Lead or support investigations involving recurring environmental findings or pathogens, including Listeria species and Listeria monocytogenes.
* Verify intensified cleaning, resampling, mitigation activities, allergen\-cleaning validation, and corrective actions.
* Ensure sanitation tools are properly segregated, dedicated, and color\-coded where required.
* Verify the proper selection, concentration, labeling, storage, dispensing, and use of sanitation chemicals.
* Ensure cleaning practices follow manufacturer instructions and established sanitation procedures.
* Evaluate equipment and facilities for harborage points, damaged surfaces, standing water, condensation, deteriorated seals, and other contamination risks.
* Participate in sanitation reviews for new equipment, renovations, construction projects, and process changes.
* Partner with Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, FSQA, chemical suppliers, and facility leadership to resolve sanitation\-related deficiencies.
* Review pest\-control programs, activity trends, and corrective actions with FSQA and facility leadership.
* Assess waste\-handling areas, docks, compactors, recycling areas, and exterior conditions for sanitation and pest risks.
* Verify sanitation procedures supporting Halal segregation and shared\-equipment controls.
* Evaluate cleaning and tool\-control practices designed to prevent allergen and Halal/non\-Halal cross\-contact.
* Lead sanitation\-related investigations and root\-cause analyses.
* Develop risk\-based corrective and preventive action recommendations.
* Verify the completion and sustained effectiveness of sanitation CAPAs.
* Identify recurring findings across facilities and recommend long\-term, systemic solutions.
* Escalate significant sanitation and food safety risks to FSQA leadership.
* Develop and deliver technical training on SSOPs, GMPs, chemical safety, sanitation verification, environmental pathogen controls, and cross\-contamination prevention.
* Coach Sanitation Managers, supervisors, FSQA personnel, Operations teams, and frontline employees.
* Verify training effectiveness through field observations and follow\-up assessments.
* Support FDA inspections, customer audits, third\-party audits, and internal food safety assessments.
* Assist facilities with regulatory observations, customer findings, CAPAs, and effectiveness verification.

jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**

  

Vertis Wealth and Law is seeking a poised, discreet and unusually strong writer who can represent the firm  

professionally on the phone and turn complex approved topics into clear first drafts. This internship  

combines client experience with disciplined brand\-content support.

 **What You Will Do**

  

* Provide scheduled phone and reception backup using approved greetings, verification, routing, and  

escalation procedures.
* Capture complete, accurate messages and protect confidential information.
* Research, outline, draft, and revise approved blog topics using credible sources.
* Write for an educated audience without giving individualized financial, legal, tax, or investment advice.
* Maintain source logs and submit all content for editorial and compliance approval; interns do not  

publish directly.

  


**What You Will Learn**

  

* Professional client communication, message accuracy, escalation judgment, and office discretion.
* Research, source evaluation, editing, brand voice, and compliant financial\-services content  

development.
* How client service, wealth management, legal services, tax planning, and marketing operate within  

one firm.

  


**Who Should Apply**

  

* You sound warm and composed on the phone and write clearly without filler.
* You are highly accurate with names, messages, deadlines, sources, and confidential information.
* You can accept detailed edits and improve a draft without becoming defensive.
* You understand that credible content requires research and review—not merely fast production.
* Sophomores, juniors, and seniors may apply; reliable in\-office attendance is essential.

Communications, public relations, journalism, English, professional writing, marketing, digital media,  

advertising, business administration, psychology, hospitality, finance, financial planning, accounting,  

economics, or pre\-law. Strong writing samples and service judgment matter more than a particular major.

 **How to Apply**  

Submit a resume, two writing samples, and a short response describing how you would handle a caller asking  

a question you are not authorized to answer. Selected applicants will complete a phone audition, message



taking simulation, editing exercise, and structured interview.  

Vertis Wealth and Law is committed to equal employment opportunity. Employment decisions are based on  

qualifications, performance, business needs, and applicable law.

Full\-time employment is not promised. Strong performers may be considered for Client Experience  

Coordinator or Marketing Coordinator openings. Account Manager consideration requires sustained service  

accuracy, at least six months of internship performance, a funded opening, and successful completion of a  

separate six\-week Account Manager training and assessment bridge.

jobs.description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.


**Technical Account Manager (TAM) – Strategic Accounts**
--------------------------------------------------------


**Okta: The World’s Identity Company™**


Okta is the leader in Identity management and The World’s Identity Company™. Our mission is to build a more secure world. Okta provides a neutral, powerful, and extensible platform that puts identity at the heart of your stack. Our platforms secure all types of identity, including customers, employees, partners, and AI agents.


Top brands trust Okta. We are relied upon by two thirds of the Fortune 100 and over 40% of the Forbes Global 2000 for their Identity\-powered journeys.


### **The Strategic Accounts Opportunity**


* **Okta Platform Focus:** Primary focus on Workforce Identity Solutions (Okta WIC), with foundational Customer Identity (Auth0\) exposure.
* **Segment Scope:** Strategic Accounts (Global enterprise clients with high\-complexity, multi\-org hybrid environments).
* **Travel:** Some travel is required, including in\-person onboarding and travel to our San Francisco, CA HQ OR Chicago office during the first week of employment.

This role is integral to the Strategic Segment team. As a P3 Technical Account Manager, you will serve as the primary technical advisor and advocate for a portfolio of Okta's largest, most complex global enterprises across industries such as Public Sector, Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Retail, and Technology.


### **Key Identity Solutions \& Technologies You Will Support**


You will guide enterprise customers through complex deployment architectures across core workforce solutions and developer\-focused identity integrations:


* **Workforce Identity Cloud (Primary Focus):**


	+ **Identity \& Access Management (IAM):** Single Sign\-On (SSO), Adaptive MFA, Device Access, API Access Management, Secure Partner Access, Access Gateway, and Universal Directory.
	+ **Identity Governance \& Administration (IGA):** Lifecycle Management, Workflows, and Identity Governance (automated SCIM provisioning and zero standing privileges).
	+ **Privileged Access Management (PAM):** Privileged Access controls.
	+ **Identity Threat Detection \& Response (ITDR):** Identity Security Posture Management, Identity Threat Protection, and Syslog integration.
* **Customer Identity \& Developer Tools:**


	+ Modern authentication protocols (**OAuth 2\.0, OIDC**).
	+ Direct API interactions using **Okta REST APIs**.
	+ **Okta Sign\-In Widget** and **Auth JS** SDKs for custom application authentication and login UI customization.

### **What You'll Be Doing**


#### **Strategic Partnership \& Account Leadership**


* Act as the primary technical authority and trusted advisor for identity leads, enterprise architects, and technical executives within your assigned strategic accounts.
* Independently design and drive multi\-year technical adoption roadmaps aligned with customer security posture and business goals.
* Partner closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Account Executives to secure Okta’s footprint against competitive displacement and identify expansion opportunities.

#### **Technical Execution, API Prototyping \& Advocacy**


* **Hands\-On Demos \& PoCs:** Configure test environments (e.g., Salesforce developer tenants) and build Proofs of Concept (PoCs) to demonstrate live SAML/OIDC integrations, custom login widgets, and Adaptive MFA policies.
* **API Validation \& Scripting:** Use **Postman** to test and validate Okta REST APIs (executing CRUD operations for user/group lifecycle management and policy automation).
* **Complex Problem Resolution:** Dissect multi\-faceted enterprise issues, proactively identify technical risks, and independently drive escalations through Engineering and Support.
* Serve as the voice of the strategic customer internally, influencing Okta product management and roadmap decisions.

#### **Thought Leadership \& Mentorship**


* Deliver custom technical workshops, architectural reviews, and best\-practice sessions for customer engineering teams.
* Develop repeatable technical assets, Postman collections, and deployment strategy guides for the global TAM organization.
* Mentor P1/P2 peers, driving team enablement and technical capability expansion.

### **What You'll Bring to the Role**


* **Experience:** 5\+ years of related technical experience in customer\-facing engineering roles (or 4\+ years with a Master’s degree), including 3\+ years as a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, or Senior Support Engineer.
* **Domain Knowledge:** 3\+ years in identity and access management (SSO, MFA, directory services, lifecycle management, or zero trust architectures).
* **Education \& Certifications:** BA/BS/MS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical discipline (or equivalent experience). Okta Certified Administrator/Consultant, CISSP, or equivalent certifications preferred.

#### **Technical Mastery**


* **Federation \& Protocols:** Practical mastery of **OAuth 2\.0**, **OpenID Connect (OIDC)**, **SAML 2\.0**, and WS\-Federation protocols.
* **API Prototyping Tools:** Hands\-on proficiency using **Postman** to execute REST API requests, manage environments/collections, and troubleshoot API integrations.
* **Development \& Web Basics:** Ability to read and modify simple web applications (e.g., HTML/JS, Node.js, Python) to demonstrate authentication flows, public vs. protected

Working closely with the Relationship Manager they will also help assist in driving growth opportunities and additional business.
