jobs.description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------


We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world\-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high\-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high\-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------



The Market Development Account Manager is responsible for securing access to and reimbursement for Teva’s CNS products and other therapies by building and nurturing strong relationships, primarily with large mental health facility and specialty pharmacy stakeholders and government organizations.


A successful individual in this role:

* Develops effective business plans to meeting and exceed area\-level goals
* Builds rapport and relationships by interacting effectively with internal and external contacts at all levels, demonstrating awareness of their needs and responding with appropriate action
* Demonstrates a collaborative approach and coordinates efforts between sales leadership, other sales teams, Field Medical, Thought Leader Liasons, Patient Services, Specialty Pharmacy, Market Access, Sales Operations, and Sales Training
* Reviews and analyzes weekly/monthly data reports and Teva suite of analytics to identify trends and develop plans to address areas of concern
* Thinks, plans, and acts strategically with long term focus versus task orientation
**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------



All areas of responsibility listed below are essential to the satisfactory performance of this position by any incumbents with reasonable accommodation if necessary. Any non\-essential functions are assumed to be included in other related duties or assignments.

* Develop and nurture strong relationships with key customers such as centers of excellence, healthcare institutions, health systems, hospitals, clinics, mental health facilities, specialty pharmacies, and government organizations.
* Leverage in\-depth knowledge of Teva’s CNS products and therapies to provide expert guidance and support to key accounts with a focus on centers of excellence, healthcare institutions, health systems and large mental health facilities.
* Create and implement strategic account plans tailored to each key customer and align them with the company’s objectives; act as point on large regional pediatric CNS facility accounts.
* Identify the unique needs and challenges of each key account and propose customized solutions that align with Teva’s products and services.
* Partner with the Specialty Pharmacy team to develop plans that align with the goals of the specialty pharmacy organization.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for cross\-functional departments on how COEs, Healthcare Institutions, Health Systems and CMHCs align with specialty pharmacy organizations for cross\-functional departments.
* Align specialty pharmacy organizations with COEs, Healthcare Institutions, Health Systems and large mental health clinics based on the pediatric mental health clinics’ needs and goals.
* Work closely with internal Teva departments such as Marketing, Patient Services, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, and Supply Chain to address customer needs and resolve any issues promptly.
* Identify and provide training and education to key account stakeholders, including healthcare professionals and staff, to ensure proper product utilization and patient care.
* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of key account relationships and regularly report progress to senior management.
* Gather feedback from key accounts and use it to continuously improve products and services as well as to address any concerns or issues.
* Collaborate with payers and government bodies to secure product access and reimbursement for psychiatric treatments.
* Perform all functions in compliance with Teva’s policies and procedures.
**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------



Any equivalent combination of education, training and/or experience that fulfills the requirements of the position will be considered.


Education/Certification/Experience:  

* Bachelor’s degree required
* Minimum of 8\+ years of progressively responsible experience in pharmaceutical/biopharma commercial roles, including proven success in key account management, strategic accounts, or national accounts
* Prior formal people leadership experience (e.g. First Line Sales Manager or equivalent) with proven experience in leading, coaching, and developing others in a formal capacity strongly preferred
* Demonstrated experience building and executing strategic account plans within IDNs, large health systems, CMHCs, or GPOs
* Experience navigating academic medical centers, HCOs, ACOs, or integrated care models in addition to traditional IDNs
* Record of accomplishment of leading and influencing cross\-functional, matrixed teams without direct authority to deliver account outcomes
* Prior experience in market access, trade, or GPO/health\-system contracting mechanics (340b, tiered GPO agreements, value\-based agreements) strongly preferred
  

Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:

* Ability to interact with customers in live and virtual environments and proficiency with technology
* Proven ability to build and sustain C\-suite and senior executive relationships
* Understanding of the buy\-and\-bill model
* Fluency in value\-based care and quality metrics (total cost of care, readmissions, HEDIS/quality measures)
* Proven written and verbal communication skills

**Job Description**

**Position:**Customer Success Manager

**Reports To****:**Director of Customer Success


**Location:**Chicago

**Job Overview**


The Customer Success Manager is responsible for helping customers obtain the most value from Reveal’s software platform. As a member of Reveal’s Customer Success team, you will build relationships, understand customer objectives and challenges, determine, and mitigate customer risk, and identify product adoption and upsell opportunities.


The ideal candidate has strong business acumen and empathy to place oneself in a “client’s shoes,” as well as demonstrated success within the eDiscovery or data forensics industries. Strong organization and time management skills are required to proactively manage and drive product adoption. Success criteria within the role will be tied to an ability to be a trusted client partner who can effectively identify and mitigate account risk and rally all levels of Reveal management to retain and ultimately increase our customers’ usage of all Reveal products.
  

  

In this role, you will work closely with a highly collaborative team and have access to many colleagues who can help ensure timely and effective responses to clients. We operate on a mostly in office schedule, with team members working onsite four days per week with work from home Fridays. This role requires a regular in\-office presence to support collaboration, training, and client service. Our office is conveniently located in the heart of Chicago with easy access to major public transportation lines.

**Responsibilities \& Duties**

* Work closely with clients to ensure successful onboarding onto the Reveal platform.
* Ability to multi\-task and proactively manage the needs of multiple accounts.
* Communicate effectively with all levels of a customer’s management team, instilling a sense of confidence in Reveal’s ability to resolve application issues.
* Understand customer health and proactively mitigate renewal risk.
* Manage and drive customer escalations to completion.

* Collaborate with internal teams to address customer challenges.
* Establish and provide eDiscovery strategies and best practices using the Reveal platform.
* Build and cultivate strong customer relationships.
* Serve as the voice of the customer internally to influence the product roadmap and to ensure features meet customer needs.

* Excellent organization and time management skills to handle multiple, competing demands.
* Ability to quickly learn and understand technology.

* Prior experience in collaborating with and building strong relationships with clients.
* Project Management experience and/or PMP certification preferred.

* FSA dependent care benefit

* Access to onsite gym and recreational area at our Chicago office

For Illinois\-based roles, the budgeted annual salary range is $93,500 to $110,000 plus participation in one of our sales commission plans. jobs.description:
Customer Sales Representative

**Chicago Heights, IL \| Full\-Time \| W2**  
**$800–$1,200 Per Week \| Weekly Pay \| Paid Training \| Commission Opportunity**

Good With People? Put That Skill to Work.

Some people are naturally good at talking to others.

They know how to start a conversation, ask the right questions, listen and make complicated choices easier to understand.

If that sounds like you, our client is expanding its customer\-facing sales team in the Chicago Heights, IL market and is hiring a **Customer Sales Representative**.

You'll work face\-to\-face with customers inside established retail partner locations, helping them understand available **services** through our client's campaign.

This is a full\-time position combining **customer service, retail sales, relationship building and account development**.

Previous telecommunications or wireless experience is not required.

**Paid training is provided.**

What You'll Actually Be Doing

This is an active, people\-facing position.

You won't spend your entire day behind a register or sitting at a desk.

Instead, you'll interact directly with customers inside partnered retail locations.

Your responsibilities include:

* Greeting and engaging customers face\-to\-face
* Starting natural, professional conversations with shoppers
* Building rapport and creating a positive customer experience
* Asking questions to understand individual household needs
* Learning about customers' current internet, mobile and connectivity services
* Educating customers on available Spectrum products and services
* Explaining current options, features, pricing and promotions clearly
* Helping customers compare available solutions
* Generating qualified customer interest and sales opportunities
* Recommending services based on individual customer needs
* Answering customer questions
* Guiding interested customers through the enrollment process
* Maintaining accurate customer and account information
* Building relationships throughout the customer experience
* Developing strong working relationships with retail employees and store leadership
* Maintaining current product and promotional knowledge
* Tracking customer interactions and individual sales activity
* Working toward individual and team performance goals
* Participating in ongoing customer service, product and sales training

Great Sales Starts With a Conversation.

We're not looking for someone who can memorize a pitch.

We're looking for someone who can understand a customer.

What are they currently using?

What are they paying for?

How many people and devices are connected in their home?

Are they streaming, gaming or working remotely?

What matters most when they're choosing a service?

You'll learn how to move naturally through:

**Conversation → Discovery → Education → Recommendation → Enrollment**

The goal is to understand first and recommend second.

That's **consultative sales**, and it's a skill that translates far beyond telecommunications.

Compensation$800–$1,200 Per Week

**Weekly Pay \| Full\-Time \| W2 \| Paid Training**

Performance\-based commission opportunities are available.

Actual compensation within the advertised range depends on experience, individual performance and the applicable compensation structure.

Complete compensation details are reviewed during the interview process.

No Telecom Experience? No Problem.

Products can be taught.

We're hiring for the qualities that are harder to teach:

**Communication. Confidence. Reliability. Coachability. Work Ethic.**

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Enjoy meeting and talking with new people
* Can confidently initiate conversations
* Naturally build relationships
* Have strong customer service instincts
* Listen before recommending a solution
* Communicate clearly and professionally
* Enjoy working toward measurable goals
* Are motivated by performance and earning potential
* Take coaching and feedback well
* Are dependable and team\-oriented
* Want opportunities for professional growth
* Are comfortable working in an active retail environment
* Have full\-time availability
* Can work weekends as required by the retail schedule

Your Experience May Be More Relevant Than You Think

You don't need a traditional sales background.

Candidates with experience in the following areas often transition well:

**Customer Service**  Retail **Restaurants**  Serving **Bartending**  Hospitality **Front Desk**  Electronics **Wireless**  Cell Phone Sales **Fitness**  Athletics **Events**  Promotions **Marketing**  Customer Relations **Account Support**  Sales

Recent graduates and entry\-level candidates are encouraged to apply.

Build Skills You Can Actually Use

This position provides hands\-on experience in:

Customer Experience

Learn how to create positive customer interactions and build trust.

Consultative Sales

Develop the ability to identify customer needs before recommending solutions.

Account Development

Understand how product education and customer enrollment contribute to account growth.

Telecommunications

Build working knowledge of internet, mobile, TV and connectivity services.

Communication

Become more confident presenting information and explaining options to different personalities.

Customer Acquisition

Learn how customer engagement develops into new business.

Performance Management

Understand how customer interactions, conversion and individual results contribute to team performance.

Looking for Growth?

For candidates interested in building a career rather than simply finding another job, strong performers may have opportunities to develop additional experience involving:

**New\-Hire Training**  Team Support **Sales Coaching**  Leadership Development **Assistant Management**  Territory Development

Advancement is based on demonstrated performance, reliability, leadership ability and business needs.

**Outside Sales Representative** **— Chicago**

Freedom Roofing Group is looking for a driven, competitive **Sales Representative** to join our growing Illinois team.

This role is for someone who wants to **build a strong book of business, earn at a high level, and take ownership of their results.**

We aren't looking for someone who needs to be constantly managed or motivated. We're looking for INSPIRED people who want to do great things and be a part of a winning team and who are willing to learn the process, get in the field, talk to homeowners, follow up consistently, and do what it takes to close business.

The right person will be responsible for the **full sales process**, from generating opportunities and inspecting properties to earning the customer's trust, closing the deal, and helping move the job successfully through the process.

This is a **field\-based sales position** for someone who is comfortable creating opportunities, meeting with homeowners, inspecting properties, and guiding customers through the roofing and exterior restoration process.

You will be expected to take ownership of your pipeline and your results.

That means prospecting when you need more opportunities, following up when a customer isn't ready to make a decision, keeping your CRM updated, and consistently moving deals forward.

Your income and growth within the company will be directly connected to your ability to produce.

* Respond to and follow up with leads quickly and consistently
* Meet with homeowners to assess roofing and exterior needs
* Perform roof and exterior inspections and accurately document findings
* Build trust with homeowners and provide a professional customer experience
* Educate customers on available roofing and exterior solutions
* Recommend solutions based on the customer's property, needs, and situation
* Present proposals and confidently ask for the sale
* Write contracts accurately and collect required documentation
* Maintain consistent communication with customers throughout the sales process
* Keep customer information, follow\-ups, and job status updated in the CRM
* Work closely with production and office teams to help ensure a smooth handoff after the sale
* Consistently hit or exceed weekly and monthly activity and sales goals
* Participate in sales meetings, training, coaching, and ongoing development
* Represent Freedom Roofing Group professionally in the field and in the community

**What We Offer**

* High income potential
* Full benefits, including:
* Health insurance
* 401(k)
* Company truck, cell, and Ipad provided
* Sales training and ongoing development
* Established systems, technology, and support
* Professional work environment
* Positive, competitive sales culture
* Long\-term growth opportunities
* Opportunity to advance into leadership based on performance

**What We're Looking For**

* Competitive and motivated to produce results
* Strong communication and people skills
* Comfortable approaching and speaking with homeowners
* Willing to prospect and create opportunities instead of waiting for leads
* Comfortable working independently and managing a sales pipeline
* Coachable and willing to follow a proven sales process
* Organized and consistent with follow\-up
* Comfortable climbing roofs and performing inspections
* Strong personal accountability
* Able to handle rejection and continue producing
* Professional appearance and communication
* Valid driver's license

**Preferred Experience (but not required)**

* In\-home sales experience
* Roofing, exterior restoration, construction, or home\-improvement sales experience
* Door\-to\-door or field sales experience
* Experience working in a commission\-driven environment
* Proven history of meeting or exceeding sales goals

**Who Will Succeed Here**

This opportunity is for someone who wants their results to be in their own hands.

If you're willing to **get in the field, create opportunities, follow up relentlessly, take care of your customers, and close business**, there is a significant opportunity to build a career with Florida Roofing and Gutters.

We provide the tools, training, systems, and support.

**You bring the effort, consistency, and drive to produce.**

If you're ready to compete, sell, and build something with a growing company, Florida Roofing and Gutters wants to hear from you.

**About Freedom Roofing Group**

Freedom Roofing Group is a growing exterior restoration company specializing in:

* Roofing

We are committed to high\-quality workmanship, strong customer service, and building a team of professionals who take pride in how they represent themselves and the company.

**Commercial Account Manager – Outside Sales, Plumbing Services (LA)**

EZ Plumbing – North Hollywood, CA  
Full\-time \| Salary \+ commission  
$48,000 base salary \+ uncapped commission \| $70,000–78,000 first year at quota \| $85,000–110,000 years two and three

EZ Plumbing has served the LA area since 1989\. We're hiring one person to build and own a book of commercial accounts: property management companies, HOAs, apartment buildings, and restaurants. Half the job is landing them. The other half is keeping them, growing them, and being the person they call. You get paid on everything your accounts spend with us for as long as they stay yours.

This is a field role. You'll be in property management offices, on job sites, and in restaurant back doors, not behind a desk.

The two halves of the job

**Landing accounts**

* Cold walk\-ins, calls, and follow\-ups to property managers, HOA boards, building owners, and restaurant operators across the LA metro
* Get EZ Plumbing onto vendor lists, get rate sheets accepted, and get maintenance agreements signed
* Deliver our vendor packet (license, insurance, W\-9, references) and walk them through it
* 15\+ in\-person visits and 40\+ total touches per week during your first year

**Managing accounts**

* Quarterly check\-in with every account in your book, in person or by phone, and a visit anytime an account goes quiet
* Own renewals: annual rate sheet updates and maintenance agreement renewals
* Grow the account: turn a one\-time repair customer into a scheduled program (drain jetting, sump and storm drain maintenance, backflow testing, water heater service, grease and floor drain service for restaurants)
* Be the first call when a property manager has a problem with a job. You don't fix it, you own it: get dispatch and the tech involved, follow it through, and call the customer back
* Stay on top of your accounts' invoices. You know the property manager, so you call before accounting does
* Track account health in ServiceTitan: last job date, revenue trend, open receivables. Nothing in your book goes 90 days without a touch
* Weekly report to the owner: new accounts, visits, accounts touched, at\-risk accounts, receivables over 60 days

Your first year is roughly 70% hunting and 30% managing. As your book grows, that flips. By year three most of your time is managing 60 to 80 accounts that pay you every month.

**Who we're looking for**

* 2\+ years outside sales, door\-to\-door, or field\-based B2B experience where you kept the accounts you signed. Route sales, uniforms, pest control, commercial cleaning, foodservice distribution, security, HVAC, or anyone who's sold to property managers: we want to talk to you
* You can walk into an office cold, get past the front desk, and leave with a name and a next step
* You follow up. Relentlessly. You have a system and you can describe it
* You've kept accounts for years, not just signed them, and you can tell us how
* You're comfortable being the person a customer calls when they're unhappy
* Organized enough to run a 50\-account book without letting any of them go cold
* Valid California driver's license and clean driving record
* Comfortable with 90% of your week in the field
* No plumbing experience required. We'll teach you what you need to sell it and manage it

**How you get paid**

* $48,000 base salary ($4,000/month), guaranteed
* $150 for every new account you sign, paid when their first invoice is paid
* 3% of everything your accounts pay us, labor and materials, for two years from the day they start, then 1% for as long as you keep the account active
* $2,000 quarterly bonus for hitting your account quota, keeping 90% of your book active, and keeping their bills current
* Year one at quota: $70,000–78,000\. Year two with a built book: $85,000–95,000\. Year three: $95,000–110,000, most of it recurring

The account management side is where the money is. The 1% that continues after year two, the retention bonus, and the growth from turning repair customers into maintenance programs are all paid for keeping accounts, not signing them.

Two things to know up front: commissions pay when the customer pays, not when the job is booked. And an account stays yours only if you're actively working it. Sign it and forget it and it goes back to the house.

**What we provide**

* Company vehicle or $500/month vehicle allowance, plus gas card
* Company phone and laptop
* All sales materials: rate sheets, one\-pagers, vendor packets, business cards
* Paid sick leave per California and City of LA law, 5 days vacation year one, 10 days year two

Not offered: health insurance, 401(k)

Schedule  
Monday to Friday, you set your own days within business hours. Exempt outside sales position, no overtime.

To apply  
Submit your resume and answer the screening questions. We read every answer. Candidates who pass move to a 15\-minute phone screen, then a ride\-along day with the owner.

EZ Plumbing is a family\-owned, C\-36 licensed plumbing contractor (CSLB \#583868\), 11478 Burbank Blvd, North Hollywood, CA 91601\.

Pay: $48,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

* Walk me through your follow\-up system. What happens after a first visit where you got a name but no commitment?
* Tell me about an account you personally kept for two or more years. What did you do to keep it, and what did you do when they were unhappy?
* How did you track your accounts in your last role? What told you an account was about to leave?
* How many in\-person cold visits did you average per week in your last sales role?
* Do you have a valid California driver's license and a driving record insurable by a commercial policy?

new_jobs.title: Business Development Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT CRAWFORD \& ASSOCIATES**


Crawford \& Associates, Inc. is a geotechnical engineering, engineering geology, and construction materials testing firm founded in 2012, now with over 85 employees across nine offices in California and Washington State. We're a team of engineers, geologists, and specialists who love solving tough problems, whether that's a bridge foundation, a water line, a new school, or the next big development. We build long\-term partnerships with our clients, give advice they can count on, and have fun doing it.  

**JOB SUMMARY**


Crawford \& Associates, Inc. is hiring a Business Development Coordinator for our Costa Mesa office that we opened this year. This role is a split between business development and recruiting. You will help find and win new work across Southern California, and help find and hire the people who deliver it. You will report to the Business Development Specialist and work closely with our principals, project managers, and construction services leadership.  

  

If you are a person who likes research, building relationships, and working with cool people, we want to hear from you.  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Business Development (approx. 50%)**** Research and track Southern California public agency opportunities, including capital improvement programs (CIPs), council agendas, planning documents, and bid/RFQ postings.
* Screen incoming leads for fit with Crawford's services and route them to the right principal or project manager with supporting research.
* Build competitive intelligence, including which firms have historically won civil and geotechnical work with target agencies.
* Maintain accurate opportunity, client, and contact information in Crawford's lead tracking system.
* Prepare for and participate in weekly proposals and business development meetings.
* Support client outreach and relationship building with agencies, prime consultants, and contractors.
* Coordinate and attend industry conferences, association events, and client meetings.

***Recruiting Support (approx. 40%)**** Partner with the Business Development Specialist, who oversees recruiting, to divide and manage open requisitions.
* Handle day\-to\-day recruiting work, with a focus on entry\-level and field roles such as engineering technicians, inspectors, interns, and staff engineers and geologists.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Indeed, job boards, referrals, and university partnerships.
* Post job openings, screen applicants, conduct initial phone screens, and schedule interviews.
* Manage candidate pipelines and keep records current in JazzHR, our applicant tracking system.
* Coordinate with hiring managers on interview feedback and next steps.
* Represent Crawford at career fairs and campus events, primarily in Southern California.

***Operational Support (approx. 10%)**** Provide light administrative support to the Costa Mesa office as needed.
* Assist with special projects in business development, recruiting, and HR as assigned.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 1 to 3 years of experience in business development, recruiting, sales, or a similar client\- or candidate\-facing role.
* Ability to travel throughout Southern California, with occasional overnight stays.
* Valid California driver's license and reliable transportation.

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines with minimal supervision.
* Team player who works well with engineers, field staff, and leadership.

  

**WORKING CONDITIONS**


This isn't a desk\-all\-day job. You'll split your time between our Costa Mesa office and getting out into Southern California: meeting clients, representing Crawford at industry events and conferences, and connecting with students at career fairs. You'll play a key role in helping us win work and supporting the people who do it. Your home base runs Monday through Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, with the occasional evening or weekend event mixed in.  

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**


Crawford \& Associates, Inc. offers a comprehensive benefits package including employer\-paid medical coverage, dental and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) plan with company matching, paid holidays, and a progressive PTO program. Additional perks include monthly cell phone reimbursement, professional membership dues and annual licensure fees (case\-by\-case), FE/EIT and PE exam fee reimbursement, and access to HSA, FSA, EAP, and CalPerks resources. Most benefits begin the first of the month following an initial 90\-day introductory period.  

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**


Crawford \& Associates, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Crawford prohibits discrimination, harassment, and retaliation on the basis of race, religion, color, sex or gender, disability or medical condition, marital status, age, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodation is available for qualified individuals with disabilities and for religious beliefs and practices.

**WHO WE ARE:**  

We are an end\-to\-end Renewable Energy provider. We offer products to commercial and enterprise clients in EV Charging solutions, Fleet Electrification, Solar Micro\-grids, Energy storage, Hydroponic farming and Rain Water/Grey Water collection systems. We have been experiencing tremendous growth in all these areas and operate under several government rebate programs that ensure a steady and reliable flow of revenues. Our company handles the entire flow of providing these products and services beginning with Sales, Provisioning, Design and Engineering, Contracting and Construction, Servicing and Maintenance. If you are passionate about the EV industry and working with awesome teams in a fast\-growing company, we want to speak with you! Join us in making a meaningful impact!  

**Job Summary**  

This role entails making cold calls and sales calls to prospects across 4 states to sell them on our EV charging products while clearly articulating the incentives, rebates, and revenues for these products. Candidates must be able to fully comprehend a rather complicated business model and articulate it effectively to the prospect, and then work with internal tools to provide proposals, contracts, case studies, model scenarios, etc. This is an hourly role with commission.  

**Responsibilities**  

* Generate and qualify new sales opportunities by conducting high\-volume cold calls, outbound sales calls, direct marketing activities, and market research to identify potential clients within the EV charging and renewable energy industries.
* Engage with prospective and existing clients by understanding their needs, clearly communicating the benefits of our products and services, and demonstrating how our solutions can address their specific business needs.
* Present and promote company products and services through phone calls, electronic communication, in\-person meetings, sales presentations, promotional materials, and other sales activities.
* Develop sales opportunities from initial contact through close by conducting follow\-ups, developing sales proposals, preparing and presenting contracts, negotiating with clients, and responding to sales inquiries and concerns.
* Maintain accurate customer and sales information by keeping customer databases and sales activity records up to date, documenting calls and sales activity, preparing sales reports, and monitoring follow\-up activities for management.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing responsive customer service, taking incoming customer calls, following up on sales activity, addressing customer concerns, and ensuring overall customer satisfaction.
* Support sales and customer education efforts by developing and maintaining sales and promotional materials, conducting product training, and providing relevant case studies, model scenarios, and other supporting information to prospective clients.
* Develop new business through referrals and networking by sourcing client referrals, participating in sales events, and identifying additional opportunities to expand the company's customer base.
* Support market and competitive research by monitoring competitors, market conditions, product development, and industry trends, as well as conducting market research and surveys.
* Perform quality and sales activity follow\-up by monitoring product and service delivery, conducting quality checks, and reporting sales activities, customer feedback, and follow\-up needs to management.

**Requirements**  

* High school diploma required; BA/BS is a plus.
* 3\-5 years of experience as a Telemarketer.
* Superb communication and customer service skills, including the ability to remain calm under pressure.
* Excellent multitasking skills.
* Comfortable making cold calls to potential clients.
* A goal\-driven, results\-oriented mindset.
* Working knowledge of computer software, including Microsoft Office Suite.
* Knowledge of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT.

**Note:** This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required.

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative - West Coast Based
new_jobs.description:
**The Company**  

  

Everflow is a SaaS Partner Marketing platform for managing and scaling revenue from affiliates, partnerships, and marketing channels.


Founded in 2016 by industry veterans, we are based in Oakland, Montreal and Amsterdam with a distributed team across the NAM and EMEA regions.  

We’re a bootstrapped company (over $30M ARR) that has grown through supporting happy customers that refer business to us and create word\-of\-mouth excitement. We’re the go\-to platform for brands, agencies, and networks, with 1,000\+ customers including Mutual of Omaha, ClassPass, and Tapjoy.###### **We are accepting applications from candidates that reside in the following areas:**

* California Bay Area \- 2 day in\-office requirement in Downtown Oakland
* LA/OC Area \- 2 Day in\-office requirement in Costa Mesa  

***the in\-office requirement is non\-negotiable***

###### **About the Role**


We are seeking a resourceful and intuitive Business Development Representative who thrives on turning complex challenges into opportunities for connection and growth. You’ll be on the ground floor of a cutting edge company disrupting the multi\-billion dollar ad industry.


As a Business Development Representative, you’ll get exposure to all types of businesses while speaking to stakeholders from ad operations to CEOs. Through a consultative and analytical approach, you’ll be able to help identify real business needs and how Everflow can help them grow.

###### **Full Interview Process:**

* Resume Review
* Recruiter Screen (30 min Zoom)
* Hiring Manager Screen (45 min Zoom)
* In\-Person Interview (up to 1 hour, with a senior member of the Sales Team, location dependent)
* Values Alignment Interview (30 min Zoom)
* References / Offer

###### **Responsibilities:**

* Educate marketing professionals on how Everflow can help them streamline processes and grow their partner marketing program
* Diligently update Hubspot, our CRM, to stay current on leads and follow ups
* Qualify all sales leads and set appointments via chat, email and phone
* Source new sales opportunities through outbound calls and marketing efforts
* Hand off qualified leads to our Account Executives
* Exhibit superior customer service in all prospect/customer engagement
* Shadow our Account Executives to help acquire skills you’ll need for your next role on the Everflow Sales Team

###### **Qualifications:**


While none of these requirements/qualifications are mandatory for hiring, candidates should demonstrate proficiency in some of these areas. As employees advance in their roles, they are anticipated to cultivate deeper expertise across all of these domains.

* Excellent communication and negotiation skills
* Experience with Hubspot is preferred but not required
* Affiliate Networking experience
* Affiliate Marketing Knowledge

###### **Requirements:**

* 1 years of experience as a SDR/BDR/LDR or similar experience
* Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in Business Administration, Communications, Economics, or other relevant field
* Prior experience and strong level of comfort with Linkedin and email outreach REQUIRED
* High energy, intelligent, driven, eager to learn, and committed to overachievement in all challenges you tackle
* Tech\-savvy, ability to problem solve within the tools you are working in
* Self\-starter with strong work ethic and drive to succeed
* Self\-sufficient
* Ability to thrive in a task and goal\-driven sales environment
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
* A can\-do attitude

###### **Compensation**


Annual Base Salary: $60,000 \- $70,000  

Uncapped Bonus Potential

###### **Perks include:**

* Employer Covered Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Unlimited PTO
* Paid parental leave for putting your family first
* Startup\-like environment, without the constant rush to raise the next round of funding
* A very collaborative team and culture
* Education, gym, and equipment stipend

### **Join Our Exceptional Team**


Dive into a role where respect, ownership, and mindfulness define our culture. As a valued team member, you'll enjoy the freedom to innovate and excel, supported by the tools and equipment you need to succeed.### **Balance, Growth, and Connection**

**Work/Life Harmony:** Embrace unlimited PTO and a healthy balance that respects your life outside work.**Continuous Growth:** Regular feedback and discussions about your career path keep you moving forward.**Inclusive Community:** Be part of a welcoming, engaging workplace that celebrates diversity and fun. **We offer a dynamic environment where excellence is rewarded, your well\-being is a priority, and every day brings a chance to make meaningful connections. Ready for a truly rewarding challenge? We're excited to meet you.**

Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off\-price retailer.

**Job Description:**

**Opportunity: Grow Your Career**

* Ensures merchandise is properly tagged, hung, secured, and coded
* Communicates with the Coordinator on Duty to ensure efficient flow of goods to sales floor
* Ensures Associates complete tasks and activities according to store plan; prioritizes as needed
* Monitors productivity of team and coaches as necessary
* Organizes and rotates back stock for easy replenishment
* Maintains and upholds merchandising philosophy and signage standards
* Maintains all organizational, cleanliness and recovery standards for the backroom area
* Ensures compliance with recycling and, where applicable, hazardous waste programs
* Communicates accurately and effectively with management and Associates when setting and addressing priorities; provides progress updates
* Provides and accepts recognition and constructive feedback
* Partners with Management on Associate training needs to increase effectiveness
* Ensures adherence to all labor laws, policies, and procedures
* Promotes credit and loyalty programs
* Supports and participates in store shrink reduction goals and programs
* Promotes safety awareness and maintains a safe environment
* Other duties as assigned

**Who We’re Looking For: You.**

* Able to work a flexible schedule, including nights and weekends
* Superior communication and organizational skills with attention to detail
* Capable of multi\-tasking
* Able to respond appropriately to changes in direction or unexpected situations
* Team player, working effectively with peers and supervisors
* Capable of lifting heavy objects with or without reasonable accommodation
* Able to train others
* 1 year retail and 6 months of leadership experience


Benefits include: Associate discount; EAP; smoking cessation; bereavement; 401(k) Associate contributions; child care \& cell phone discounts; pet \& legal insurance; credit union; referral bonuses. Those who meet service or hours requirements are also eligible for: 401(k) match; medical/dental/vision; HSA; health care FSA; life insurance; short/long term disability; paid parental leave; paid holidays/vacation/sick; auto/home insurance discounts; scholarship program; adoption assistance. All benefits are provided in accordance with and subject to the terms of the applicable plan or program and may change from time to time. Contact your TJX representative for more information.

TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. new_jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator (Contract)
new_jobs.description:
**About Glean:**
Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles.
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more \- deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
  

**About the Role:**  

  

  

We’re hiring a Recruiting Coordinator (6 month contract) to join our team! In this role, you’ll be an essential part of our hiring efforts, helping to ensure a smooth and efficient interview process, and assisting in recruiting operations. You’ll work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates to create a seamless and positive experience from start to finish. We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys managing multiple tasks at once, and is excited to contribute to a high\-impact, collaborative team.  

  

  

**You will:**
* Schedule, coordinate, and confirm candidate interviews across multiple time zones
* Greet onsite candidates and ensure a warm, professional, and seamless interview experience
* Handle all cancellations and reschedule interviews promptly and efficiently
* Communicate changes to relevant parties and update internal systems accordingly
**About you:**
* 1\-2 years of relevant experience
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills with consistent follow\-through
* Clear, professional communication and time management skills
**Location:**
* This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our SF Office)
**Compensation \& Benefits:**
The hourly rate for this role is $38 \- $40\. This is a contract position and is not eligible for company benefits.
  

\#LI\-HYBRID  

  

**AI\-First Mindset at Glean:**
At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI\-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our **Privacy Policy**. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our **Applicant Arbitration Agreement**.

new_jobs.title: Production Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

  

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem\-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

  



Wherever you sit in the organization, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and gives you the opportunity to shape your career and the world around you.

  



The Production Coordinator is a critical plant operations role responsible for ensuring accurate system execution, production reconciliation, workforce administration, and operational continuity across manufacturing this role. This role serves as the backbone of production system integrity and people process execution, with strong emphasis on SAP system accuracy \- financial integrity, and production support.


Responsibilities:
**Production Systems and SAP Reconciliation**

* Provide ongoing SAP support and own reconciliation for startup runs and end of round transactions.
* Ensure accurate timing and compliant production postings.
Investigate discrepancies and coordinate corrective actions.  
* 

**Raw Materials Validation and Documentation**

* Perform data entry system updates as required to support uninterrupted operations.

**Production Execution Support**

* Own and execute ZARPAC push and PTS push activities to ensure accurate production and material consumption reporting.
* Serve as the key support function during off shifts, ensuring continuity of production system execution.

**Workforce Administration and Scheduling**

* Own production team member scheduling activities within elevated team member environments
* Manage and maintain attendance tracking, payroll inputs \& validation, and PARs (Personnel Action Requests)
* Support staffing coordination to ensure adequate coverage and alignment to production plans
* Act as the primary point of accountability for labor administration accuracy and timeliness

**Operational Enablement \& Partnership**

* Enable elevated team members by removing administrative and system barriers to execution.
* Partner Cross functionally with plant leadership, planning, and maintenance teams to resolve production system and labor issues.
* Identify gaps, risks or reoccurring issues and proactively recommend improvements to processes and ways of working.

**Training and Support**

* Provide training and support to production staff on SAP usage and best practices.
* Act as a subject matter expert, assisting users with troubleshooting and resolving system\-related issues.

Description:

Job Title: Sales Coordinator – Data Center


Location: Fremont, CA (Onsite)


Company: Yinlun TDI LLC


About Yinlun TDI LLC


Yinlun TDI LLC is a leading provider of advanced thermal management solutions for the U.S. automotive, commercial truck, and off highway markets. Following the acquisition by Zhejiang Yinlun Co., Ltd., Yinlun TDI has further strengthened its engineering expertise and manufacturing capabilities in the United States.


Headquartered in Houston, TX, Yinlun TDI LLC maintains sales and engineering facilities in California, Michigan, and Illinois. With strong support from our parent company, we are well positioned for continued growth across conventional heat exchangers, hybrid, electric vehicle (EV), and autonomous driving sectors.


Yinlun TDI LLC is an ISO 14001 and IATF 16949 certified manufacturer of heat exchangers and fluid cooling components for automotive, commercial truck, bus, and industrial markets


Position Overview


We are seeking a motivated Sales Coordinator to support our growing Data Center business in North America. This is an early\-career opportunity for someone interested in developing a career in B2B sales, account management, and the rapidly growing data center industry.


We are looking for someone who is organized, responsive, comfortable communicating with customers, and eager to learn.


Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain relationships with customers.
* Support new customer development through outreach, follow\-up, and opportunity tracking.
* Participate in customer meetings and gradually take ownership of assigned accounts.
* Prepare quotations, presentations, proposals, and other commercial materials.
* Coordinate customer requirements with engineering, operations, and global teams.
* Track sales opportunities, customer activities, forecasts, and follow\-up actions.
* Conduct market and customer research to identify potential business opportunities.
* Support customer visits, trade shows, and other business development activities.
* Develop working knowledge of Yinlun’s data center thermal management products and applications.


Requirements:

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, account management, or a similar customer\-facing commercial role.
* Demonstrated interest in developing customers and building long\-term business relationships.
* Strong communication, presentation, organization, and follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable working with both customers and technical/internal teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Benefits

* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonus
* Comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, life insurance)
* Short\-term and long\-term disability coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid vacation, sick time, holidays, and floating holidays
* Career growth opportunities in a fast\-paced, global environment

new_jobs.title: Leasing Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About ArtHaus Properties**### **The expanded ArtHaus Properties operating company is a wholly owned subsidiary of Arthaus Partners, purpose\-built to manage and scale our vertically integrated residential platform. This role offers a rare opportunity to help shape the future of operations at a company on the verge of doubling its footprint, bringing structure, innovation, and excellence to a portfolio with significant near\-term growth ahead. It’s an exciting moment to lead, build, and leave your mark.**

 **Leasing Operations Coordinator — ArtHaus Properties**  

 Oakland / East Bay, CA (Hybrid) \| $31–$33/hr \| Full\-Time

 **Ready to be the engine behind a growing leasing team?**


ArtHaus Properties is looking for a sharp, energetic Leasing Operations Coordinator to be the right hand to our Director of Leasing. This isn't a desk\-bound admin role — you'll be out at properties making sure every unit, tour, and ad actually lives up to our brand, while also digging into data and coordinating with a leasing team spread across the globe. If you're the kind of person who spots the one thing that's slightly off before anyone else does, and you're hungry to grow into bigger leasing operations and marketing responsibility, we want to talk to you.

 **What you'll do:**

* **You set the first impression.** Score curb appeal, entry sequence, common areas, and unit condition on every tour — flag it, don't fix it, and keep the ministaging inventory sharp and ready to deploy.
* **You're the last line of defense on brand.** Catch pricing, availability, and brand\-standard slip\-ups before they ever go live.
* **You make the numbers trustworthy.** Keep the systems clean and build the reports leadership actually relies on.
* **You keep leasing moving.** Help launch portfolio\-wide initiatives, group leasing outreach, and the AIGT (AI\-Guided Tour) program — and keep an eye on lead response and service quality across the team.
* **You're the closer's closer.** Jump in on application review and approval to help move renters across the finish line.

 **What you bring:**

* A few years in multifamily leasing, marketing, or operations (property management experience is preferred)
* An eye for detail and a genuine drive to make things better, not just check boxes
* Comfort with tech\-forward systems and the Google Suite
* Great communication — you can rally a global team and hold vendors accountable
* Reliable transportation to get around the Bay Area for property visits, primarily in Oakland
* A growth mindset — this is a launchpad role for someone who wants to build a career in leasing operations

 **Why ArtHaus:**  

You'll work directly with leadership, get exposure to every corner of the leasing and marketing operation, and have real room to grow as the role (and the portfolio) expands.

**Minimum Requirements**
========================

* Strong organizational and project\-management skills across competing deadlines and multiple properties.
* Comfort coordinating with global or distributed teams and holding service\-quality standards.
* Clear written and verbal communication; ability to translate standards into practical guidance for property\-level teams.
* Based in or willing to work from the Oakland/East Bay area, with ability to travel to properties as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Three or more years in multifamily leasing, marketing, or leasing operations.
* Experience overseeing quality control across property presentation, marketing materials, or brand standards.
* Working knowledge of Yardi (or comparable property management software) and reporting tools (Excel, Google Workspace).
* Familiarity with application review and Fair Housing\-consistent screening practices. Direct experience supporting a leasing leadership role.
* Background in centralized or corporate leasing operations across a multi\-property portfolio.
* Experience with group leasing outreach or business/community partnership development.
* Familiarity with competitive market research and pricing analysis.
* Yardi experience (any version).
* Familiarity with application review and Fair Housing\-consistent screening practices.

**Working Conditions**
======================

* Mix of desk\-based work (quality control, reporting, coordination) and property site visits for presentation walk\-throughs.
* Time\-sensitive cycles around unit turns, marketing launches, and initiative rollouts.
* Regular coordination with the leasing team.
* Based in Oakland/East Bay with periodic travel across the portfolio.
 **The pay range for this role is:**  

31 \- 33 USD per hour(ArtHaus Works)

new_jobs.title: Inside Territory Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Inside Territory Account Manager (ITAM) will manage an assigned territory in support of the SMB team. The ideal candidate will have experience in the networking and/or security sectors of technology. The ITAM will create and execute the account plan from prospecting to building and maintaining a constant revenue pipeline. Drive sales cycles to close while establishing relationships and credibility. Provide necessary presales support for prospects/customers. Work closely with Channel Teams and our reseller partner network to drive deals and increase revenue. Fortinet will provide detailed and ongoing training programs. Once completed you will be assigned a territory, quota and given ongoing support to begin your career at Fortinet.


**Responsibilities:**

* Meet or exceed all assigned quotas and targets
* Forecast weekly, monthly and quarterly revenues for territory
* Follow up on inbound, web and corporate event generated opportunities
* Accept inbound and perform outbound telephone calls to identify sales opportunities.
* Meet and exceed daily call \& activity metrics.
* Manage customer presentation and demos via online tools (GO TO MEETING)
* Track sales opportunities (MGOs, deal registration, quotes etc. in Salesforce)
* Align with channel and partner teams to support overall company revenue targets
* Perform ongoing research and report on opportunities that are supported
* Act as a liaison between partner, customers, and appropriate Fortinet team members
* Perform other duties and projects, as assigned to support the growth or our business

**Required Qualifications:**

* A proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas and targets
* Understanding of the sales cycle in conjunction with business processes internally and externally
* Ability to manager and drive sales cycle from start to finish
* Ability to manage a diverse, high volume workload; self\-motivated and adaptable
* Ability to quickly build productive relationships in a fast\-paced, high\-performance environment
* Must have proficiency with various software applications programs
* Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills
* Experience with managing and forecasting individual quota
* Well organized with effective time and activity management skills
* Ability to apply entrepreneurial strengths in a forward\-thinking manner
* Proven work\-ethic and time\-management skills
* Ability to close business while achieving a high level of customer and partner satisfaction
* Public/private cloud experience is a plus
* Experience with multi\-tier distribution a plus.
* The Inside Territory Account Manager is required to customarily and regularly work outside of their office or home office engaged in selling, including travel as needed to make a sale.
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship  
* 

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.


Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. On target earnings for this position is expected to be $125,000 \- $145,000 per year. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.


All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, and this position is also eligible for commissions based on the terms of the Sales Compensation Plan

The primary responsibility for Gordian Account Managers is to provide support, and training, for products and services centered around Job Order Contracting (JOC) for various Clients.

* Ability to train contractors in Gordian software, client procedure and assist in client contract bidding
* Communicate clearly and effectively with clients and internal team members to ensure projects are completed on time and on budget
* Manage multiple accounts; develop positive working relationships with all customers.
* Drive client retention, renewals, upsells and client satisfaction.
* Work closely with Project Managers and Account Managers on day\-to\-day operational processes including, but not limited to contract renewals, prepare and maintain schedules to accomplish procurement objectives, troubleshooting, provide software training to client and contractor staff.
* Work closely with to determine root cause of customer success and failures and drive requirements for process enhancement and development as needed.
* Partner with internal cross\-functional teams to understand customer goals and key performance metrics and exceed those goals yearly.
* Provide input on new processes and workflow as needed.
* Focus on ensuring we maintain superior customer service levels, operational excellence and strategic insight.
* Collaborate closely with construction management firms to promote consistency and while developing standards and procedures.
* Work closely with Finance on billing setup and invoicing.
* Participate in Budget development and management, revenue forecasting
* Work with Sales and Business Operations team to develop annual program usage and benchmark report.
* Ability to monitor and follow through on all construction/project related activities to ensure work adequately reflects clients' needs and is executed in a continuous, prompt manner within the project budget.
* Ability to review contractors' requests for changes and, if appropriate, initiate job order supplementals
* Ability to interact with owner representatives, contractors, and facility end\-users, to minimize project concerns.
* Experience reviewing contractor's’ daily inspection reports, summarizing, and reporting on construction progress weekly, to upper management.
* Travel 50\-70% within assigned geographic area

 **Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field, or comparable work experience
* 5\+ years of construction procurement, construction management, project management, or general contracting related experience in both facilities and road construction preferred.
* Extensive knowledge and experience in public construction operations, pricing and contracting, including scope development and estimating/price proposal development
* High level analytical skills and problem\-solving capabilities, and the ability to effectively manage several projects simultaneously in development and in the field during construction.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills, strong interpersonal and team building skills, flexibility, strategic thinking, problem solving skills, goal driven, client obsessed, ability to deliver results, meets client and corporate deadlines, time management skills, self\-motivated, works well independently and in a group dynamic
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products, including Word, Excel, PowerBi, ability to develop and generate custom tracking documents and reports
* Background in construction documentation and administration preferred, but not required
* Job Order Contracting or IDIQ experience is preferred, but not required, comprehensive understanding of various public procurement and project delivery methods and requirements.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in quota\-carrying cloud or software sales, or consultative account management at a business\-to\-business (B2B) software company.
* Experience working with internal teams and customer stakeholders.
* Experience managing the full sales cycle (e.g., pipeline management, forecasting, reporting).
* Experience managing commercial negotiations and agreements.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with consultative selling to executives, asking insightful, visionary questions, presenting future\-forward proposals, and building multi\-year account strategies and plans.
* Experience supporting large enterprise organizations, expanding existing accounts, securing new customers, and accelerating consumption business.
* Experience qualifying leads and presenting the value proposition of cloud, data, and AI technologies against customers’ strategic business opportunities and challenges. Experience showcasing current technology trends and Google Cloud differentiators.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and partners in project implementation and negotiation.
* Experience with complex agreements structuring, negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements, and supporting multi\-year engagements.
* Demonstrated business and financial acumen.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.



As a Field Sales Representative (FSR) supporting Strategic Accounts, you are a partner, leading the growth strategy for our strategic customers and partners. You will engage customers with consultative value promoting methodology to transform their business. Within a large account team, you'll harness all of Google's assets to support the customers' success. You will be deeply invested in the customers' industry, their engaged environment, technical issues, financial models, and business goals. You’ll leverage experience engaging with executives to establish and build relationships.
  

  

You will drive long\-term business growth by gaining a deep understanding of customers' critical issues and aligning them with Google Cloud's portfolio of solutions. You will lead the end\-to\-end sales process, from initiating customer conversations to orchestrating teams to deliver business commitments and increased consumption. You will advocate the innovative power of our products and solutions to make organizations more productive, collaborative, and mobile.

new_jobs.description:
**About Roger**  

Roger is an AI platform that frees home health clinicians from paperwork so they can focus on what matters: delivering life\-changing care to our most vulnerable elderly patients in the comfort of their homes. Backed by leading healthcare investors like SignalFire, we've powered millions of visits, deployed to thousands of clinicians, and we're just getting started.

**Job Overview**  

We are looking for Business Operations team members to join our early team. This is a role for a sharp, scrappy operator who wants to learn the business by working in it. Depending on company needs, you will be placed in one area of the business, such as customer operations, revenue operations, people operations, or hiring, and own it end to end.


You will work directly with founders and team leads, and there may be opportunities to take on work in other areas over time as the company grows. This is not a narrow role with a rigid playbook. You will figure things out, build systems, and take real ownership of your area.


You need to be genuinely curious, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by the idea that no problem is "not your job."

**What You Might Work On**  

Your focus will shift as the company grows. You may dive into any of these areas:

* **Hiring:** Step in as an interim hiring manager, run interview loops, track the data, and manage agency and recruiter relationships.
* **People Ops:** Own employee onboarding, support HR processes, and help build the systems that keep a growing team running smoothly.
* **Revenue Operations:** Manage our sales tools, clean and maintain CRM data, and set up workflows and automations that make the GTM team faster.
* **Customer and Support Operations:** Partner with our success and support teams on scheduling, tracking, and process improvements, and help investigate customer issues across teams.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Work with engineering, finance, and leadership to unblock projects and keep things moving.
* **Special Projects:** Build dashboards and metrics for the C\-suite, run analyses, and take on whatever high\-priority project comes up next.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Take projects from ambiguous idea to finished result with minimal oversight.
* **Operational Execution:** Keep the details straight: follow\-ups, record\-keeping, and coordination so nothing falls through the cracks.
* **Systems Building:** Spot broken or manual processes and replace them with clean, scalable workflows.
* **Data and Insights:** Build dashboards, track key metrics, and surface insights that help leadership make better decisions.
* **Cross\-Team Partnership:** Work closely with founders and team leads, and be the person people rely on to get things done.
* **Fast Learning:** Quickly pick up new tools, domains, and workflows, including how home health works and where Roger fits into it.

**Requirements:**

* **Experience:** 2\+ years of professional experience, with prior startup experience required. Backgrounds in operations, RevOps, BizOps, customer success, or similar roles are a strong fit.
* **Fast Learner:** Picks up unfamiliar domains, tools, and processes quickly. Healthcare exposure is a plus but not required.
* **Detail Oriented:** Catches the small things others miss, keeps clean records, and takes pride in precision.
* **Strong Communicator:** Clear, warm, and professional with teammates, candidates, customers, and leadership.
* **Data Comfortable:** Able to work in dashboards, CRMs, and spreadsheets, and use data to spot opportunities.
* **Startup Generalist:** Comfortable with ambiguity, motivated by mission, and energized by ownership in a fast\-paced environment. Eager to jump into any part of the business and execute well.

**Why Join Us?**  

Platinum health, dental, and vision insurance  

Unlimited PTO  

Retirement: 401(k) plan  

Unmatched career growth as an early hire, with exposure to every part of the business  

Work on a mission that matters, backed by AI innovation and top\-tier investors

**Make a Real Difference \- Hear from our Users:**  

"If I had to give Roger a rating out of 10, I'd give it an 11! You guys changed my life!!" \- G.M. from San Francisco, Registered Nurse  

"Roger AI saves me hours per day. I can easily focus on my patients now too." \- J.L. from Tucson, Registered Nurse  

"Being a single mom is tough, but with Roger I can take the time to go to my daughter's soccer game and also pursue further education." \- T.M. from Dallas, Licensed Vocational Nurse


Compensation Range: $110K \- $160K

Their goal is to create streets that are livable, supporting safety, accessibility, inclusion, resiliency, active modes, community cohesion, and economic vitality citywide. Additionally, they aim to enhance New York City's pedestrian, bicycle, and micromobility networks, providing comfortable, connected, green, and reliable transportation options across the five boroughs. They place special emphasis on Priority Investment Areas, mode shift, and reimagining streets. The office also develops innovative new programs, design typologies, project delivery, and analysis tools to meet the demands of a rapidly changing population with evolving needs and technologies.
  

  

The NYC DOT Transportation Planning and Management Division (TPM), OLS is seeking a Street Improvement Project (SIP) Coordinator; SIPs involve the use of the agency’s operations teams to implement rapid and meaningful changes to city streets, including Vision Zero safety projects, bus priority projects, bicycle network projects, pedestrian priority projects, among others. The SIP\-Central team within OLS is responsible for organizing and prioritizing an increasingly complex work program across agency. The SIP\-Central team also analyzes and determines implementation capacities to communicate realistic annual work plans; leads coordination with other agencies; and uses database tracking and improving efficiencies to increase output while advancing project quality.
  

  

Under the direction of the Director of Street Improvement Projects, the selected candidate will provide critical support to the Street Improvement Projects (SIP) program by aligning project implementation schedules with resurfacings, traffic signal construction, state of good repair work, and other programs within and external to DOT. The candidate will be responsible for improving efficiency by coordinating with multiple divisions to inform the sequencing of new Street Improvement Projects and upgrades to existing SIPs; they will work independently and collaboratively and be required to manage and reconcile multiple competing priorities. Responsibilities include identifying project overlaps and conflicts, communicating dynamically with various stakeholders, aligning schedules, and pro\-actively advancing implementation priorities across multiple units and agencies.
  

  

The candidate will streamline project delivery by identifying upcoming SIP locations that either overlap with the agency’s scheduled state of good repair work, or where the physical and fiscal integrity of the project would benefit from a resurfacing. The candidate will strategize, prioritize, and track requests to align resurfacing dates with SIP implementations. Working with the Deputy Director of SIPs, the candidate will also manage upcoming SIP locations with signal construction work that overlaps with scheduled resurfacings to inform signal construction priorities and timelines. The candidate will use the SIP Portal, maps and databases to identify existing SIPs scheduled for resurfacing or refurbishment, coordinate with project managers or their delegates to determine treatment changes or upgrades, and work with the Deputy Director to prioritize updates in the design queue. Candidate will coordinate with the Furniture and Operations Unit to plan for temporary furniture relocations related to resurfacings, liaise with internal and external partners on other agency or city\-wide initiatives, and perform additional tasks related to the assigned role as needs arise.
  

  

The Department of Transportation’s (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents. DOT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to recruiting and maintaining a diverse workforce in an open and inclusive environment.

* Attend fit sessions to review details needed to prepare block/make detail requests
* Initiate and track style development from concept through production, ensuring all approvals are met per calendar deadlines
* Responsible for all daily communication with overseas offices
* Drive product development calendar adherence
* Build effective relationships with internal partners in Design, Sales, Merchandise Planning, and Supply and Operations to help execute cross functional synergy and collaboration
  

  

**What You'll Bring:**

  

  

* 1\-3 years’ experience recommended in product development, merchandising or other related work experience
* Strong organizational skills
* Strong sense of teamwork and ability to multitask
* Work independently
* Excellent communication skills
* Detail oriented and ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment
* High energy level and must work well under pressure
